As a legislator, I voted 100% for life, and I co-authored Parent's Right to Know and Positive Alternative Act, both of which were signed into law. During my time as Senate Majority Leader, the Senate added additional legal defense against a lawsuit that sought to eliminate many of Minnesota's pro-life laws. Unfortunately, many of the bills I worked on, including ending all taxpayer funding for abortion, were vetoed. That is the exact reason why we need a pro-life Republican in the Governor's office. **As I said at the annual March for Life last January,_"These are the legislators that stand in the gap for life. We’re pro-life proud!”_** [_**Are you pro-life proud?**_](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=3fcb452ec5b84111b419c69f3fa50201&_m=ff33568a8b2d484a8748de37f7738eca&_e=bGyrL7PGLE8p0RLbD6xkeoZFb0K5V07OwpmuqV39kKUhvEkUMvxcc0tsA0uV769FT7Vuqb11sWS7Ywt7OIg1uEFtGutPXDMfChSyuWg5wVJduTtKd0N87Aa2ooSYWCthuH1d7UAbO81Nr-crdr_eWhtduvcyDglKKJ9Pia_QWIMjZlBi-0wVJuMRbZ73MAOKInlpi0m54UTie1VdlCduX0pvNimeo0CJ2Aojb475HY9YT2RaYr_lbIQrleooJ80l3qQAkoHqIj0wTAuAHSIrPIH3MsWJShAucJdSesdymcmShptr8c0BGw1IsKSSw2h-7fElWFn5BsMuodLC1y_fnGDqRKKCfeEMEZ6uhtaTcuE%3D) [**Join Me In Supporting Life >> Donate NOW**](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=3fcb452ec5b84111b419c69f3fa50201&_m=ff33568a8b2d484a8748de37f7738eca&_e=bGyrL7PGLE8p0RLbD6xkeoZFb0K5V07OwpmuqV39kKUhvEkUMvxcc0tsA0uV769FT7Vuqb11sWS7Ywt7OIg1uEFtGutPXDMfChSyuWg5wVJduTtKd0N87Aa2ooSYWCthuH1d7UAbO81Nr-crdr_eWqdY510Lh6mJr8rorTGV6Z4L4sXcVpe-_BgN_2j42sP1b4qZv9qFH8IR4TkF06DDD50w_RbrAk8QjTcoWVKmqCb0WKPVZt0D61e_B2twnASJOuQqoMhLj7syAkm7zzG72_vNOVWBkwoImvCoYCVFhPUMQZX06NECIg17CmNvM3PM6Fn2uQu8QczH2fO54GixBIWiryyTH2delYZ4VFzbU-4%3D) I never compromised my pro-life values as Senate Majority Leader, and I won't compromise as your Governor. # [Mexican Cartels Fly 9,000 Drone Flights into U.S. to Surveil Law Enforcement Operations](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58573&L=27119&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2FydGVscy1mbHktZHJvbmVzLWludG8tdXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Y29ycnVwdGlvbitjaHJvbmljbGVzJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=)
Mexican drug cartels have conducted more than 9,000 drone flights into U.S. airspace in the last year to surveil American law enforcement and security operations in the southern border region, a senior Homeland Security official told Judicial Watch this week. The drones are observing federal, state, county, and city agencies near the Mexican border, including the U.S. Border Patrol, Texas Department of Public Safety, Texas National Guard, county sheriffs and local police. The Border Patrol, which operates under Customs and Border Protection (CBP), has captured about a dozen of the drones, and accessed the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles’ (UAVs) guidance and memory systems to gain intelligence information, according to a high-level official at the agency.

The Russians have failed to take Kyiv. Rather than take ALL of Ukraine, Putin may be satisfied with taking SOME of it. Biden's spokesman said our goal should be strengthening Ukraine's position at the negotiating table. Is that enough? Read my thoughts in this week's blog. [Read this entry >>](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjlktky-kujkulhluu-t/)

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/8598?t=6&akid=1821%2E878179%2Ej9kW8i) Friend, Runoff races aren't cheap -- especially as a first-time, progressive, grassroots candidate who refuses to be bought by corporations and special interests.

[**We 're fighting an uphill battle with this race and we need all hands on deck to make sure we have the resources to power through the next couple months. Can you split a donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project now to put us in the best position possible for the runoff on May 24?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/8598?t=7&akid=1821%2E878179%2Ej9kW8i) | [DONATE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/8598?t=8&akid=1821%2E878179%2Ej9kW8i)
---
Even though the dust and excitement from the primary have settled, we're still on the ground and online reminding people that we have a runoff election coming up.

We're doing blockwalks, knocking doors, and showing up at events to make sure that we're able to make face-to-face connections with people in our communities.

We're still using digital tools like texting and virtual phone banks to make sure we're able to reach out to South Texans we can't talk to in person.

On top of that, we want to make some big investments in ads and media to make sure that we're getting this campaign in front of as many people as possible so they know who we are and why this runoff is important.

Turnout for primaries in Texas is historically low -- even more so for primary runoffs -- so taking all of those steps is critical. And all of that comes with costs that we need our supporters to help out with.

[**Will you split a donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us cover the expenses of this runoff race? Every little bit helps us reach another voter and get one step closer to winning on May 24.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/8598?t=9&akid=1821%2E878179%2Ej9kW8i)

Dear Fellow American, If you think the BLM mobs looting stores and burning down buildings were scary...you should see what I witnessed right here in my own school. My name is Jon Lizak, and I'm a sophomore at The State University of New York at Binghamton. Since I'm the president of our conservative student club, I was excited to help sponsor a lecture by famed economist Dr. Art Laffer on campus last fall. Students were supposed to hear Dr. Laffer talk about how free markets and limited government made America great. **[But that’s not what happened – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you in the hope you’ll help conservative students like me in defending free speech on campus with a tax-deductible gift to Young America’s Foundation today.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3vjjuldo2ct7oaing739q88hhr851ti4ai0m7n8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) ** [**MAKE MY GIFT TO DEFEND FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUS**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1idmnkmrrblhu9dql8db5tbd7klfdiupvt63sfo_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) Instead, nearly 200 angry protestors started to gather in and outside of the lecture hall on the day of the event. At this point, my friends and I were getting pretty nervous, but we figured as long as most of the protestors stayed outside, we'd be alright. As soon as Dr. Laffer stepped to the podium, more than 100 protestors poured into the room -- ambushing Dr. Laffer's speech and screaming obscenities into a bullhorn. They stood on tables, screaming and shouting. Some wore bandanas to hide their faces. Others wore masks. The leftists' bullhorn was even equipped with a light designed to "blind" the person standing in its path. These violent radicals yelled in the faces of campus police and screamed that Dr. Laffer was a "racist" and a "bigot." As the mob grew louder and larger, conservative students in the audience remained calm and courageous. _But what happened next was truly shocking._ **Instead of campus police removing the rioters, Dr. Laffer was ordered to cancel his own speech and leave the stage!** I could hear the leftist mob chanting "No justice, no peace!" down the hallway as they followed campus police escorting Dr. Laffer from the building. I'm still shocked at the hate that was directed at Dr. Laffer and the conservative students who came to hear him that day. I'm angry that the money we raised to help cover Dr. Laffer's trip here - as well as to book the lecture hall - was wasted. And I'm outraged that our right to free speech was SHUT DOWN BY LEFT-WING RADICALS WHO DON'T WANT ANYONE ELSE'S VIEWS SHARED ON CAMPUS. ** ** **Binghamton University knowingly and willingly deprived us of our rights - and put the "rights" of foul-mouthed, violent protestors ahead of ours.** The Left has been getting away with this kind of intimidation at schools across the country. But here at Binghamton, we are fighting back! **Thanks to the conservative powerhouse organization Young America's Foundation (YAF), we are SUING Binghamton University for denying conservative students like me our right to free speech.** **[Now I urgently need your help. With your tax-deductible gift to Young America’s Foundation today, you’ll directly defend free speech on campus and the rights of students to hear conservative ideas at SUNY-Binghamton and nationwide.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcr2b0fuc7v704gvs270k65sq8husqrd3neficr8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) ** [**MAKE MY GIFT TO DEFEND FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUS**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ze2m9hana3kbibihuvbvbjjp6ivdlqd8l2j06re8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) If you've heard of Young America's Foundation, then you know they are standing up for the rights of conservative students who are sick and tired of being silenced by the radical Left. And YAF gets results. **YAF sued UC Berkeley and won!****** Thanks to YAF's recent landmark free speech lawsuit, UC Berkeley can no longer silence conservative speakers on campus. Leftist school officials help create campus environments of hate and intolerance that make it dangerous for conservative speakers - and then require students to pay outrageous "security fees" without paying a dime themselves. Now conservative students at Berkeley will no longer have the burden of these enormous "security fees" placed upon them. **YAF also took the University of Florida to court – and won!** When the University of Florida denied conservative students requested funds to bring conservative speakers to campus, the University refused to provide them with the same support they provide leftist student groups. But YAF forced them to reverse their unfair policy. And YAF's defense of conservative students isn't just in the courtroom -- they are standing up for us in the classroom too. Recently a student whistleblower at Iowa State University called YAF's Campus Bias Tip Line to expose a professor who threatened to **kick students out of her class if they disagreed with abortion or the Black Lives Matter movement.** _**_Within one day_**_ , thanks to pressure from YAF, Iowa State ordered this professor to drop her discriminatory class policy and respect the First Amendment rights of ALL students! Yes, YAF is putting schools on notice: Left-wing teachers and administrators don't have a right to bully and censor students like me who don't support socialism, the Marxist BLM movement, and tearing down statues of our Founding Fathers! But this battle against my school will not be easy. Administrators are already digging in their heels and insisting that they "acted consistent with...the requirements of the First Amendment." The truth is the only people who got "free speech" that day were the protestors. Dr. Laffer was never allowed to utter a word of his speech. That isn't free speech...it's a "heckler's veto" - and it's time for this kind of violent mob rule to be shut down. Obviously, as a 19-year-old student, there's no way I could ever fund a lawsuit like this on my own. That's why I'm so grateful that Young America's Foundation is stepping up to protect our rights as conservatives. But remember, enormous state schools such as Binghamton have millions of dollars in taxpayer funding lining their pockets. That's why YAF must rely on American patriots like you who care that YOUR values will be passed on to the next generation. [**I hope you will consider supporting Young America's Foundation in their mission to pass on your ideas to future generations and legal actions against schools that violate students' legal rights with a tax-deductible gift of $35 or more today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z4qqm3aev7rn9ufll0m0bj1tjuue843t70s4spf0_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs)**** [**MAKE MY GIFT TO DEFEND FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUS**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zh1ng07lk89hr3ee3i1g9jfktj3f9l98qmogr5o0_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) Students at The State University of New York at Binghamton and countless other schools need the support and resources YAF provides to stand up to leftist agitators. YAF's conservative campus lecture program has enabled millions of students to hear about your conservative American values. You see, in addition to Dr. Art Laffer, YAF sends **Ben Shapiro, Dinesh D'Souza, Katie Pavlich, Dr. Walter Williams, Steve Forbes,** and many other conservative leaders to speak to students nationwide. Plus, YAF is the organization that saved President Ronald Reagan's California ranch for future generations of conservatives. Today the "Reagan Ranch" gives young people an escape from the leftist intolerance and hate found on many college campuses. Visiting the Ranch allows young Americans like me (who have no memory of Reagan's presidency and aren't taught about him in school) to really understand his legacy, so we can revere and emulate this great leader. Frankly, nobody does youth outreach like Young America's Foundation. **YAF is the one true leader in producing America's next conservative leaders.** **[That's why I hope you'll help me and students like me to hear YOUR conservative ideas with a gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, $500, $1,000 or more to Young America's Foundation today.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk5g02jifctqclgo84d3rtag6ralcse4ehvh9sg8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs)** If you're able to give a very special gift of $1,000 or more, your name, or the name of a loved one, will be engraved on Freedom Wall at the Reagan Ranch. [**MAKE MY GIFT TO DEFEND FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUS**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd4nb8grgp7c506qttmua81qqr3tmk02qo05msv0_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs) As I said, YAF doesn't receive one dime of federal funding. Instead, they depend entirely on the generous support of American patriots like you. So, if you agree that conservative speakers who share your values and ideas shouldn't be silenced by leftist mobs, professors, and administrators... [**I hope you'll make an urgent tax-deductible gift of $35 or more to Young America's Foundation today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2za2l8qs5t2lpm1e2t64itcuk0itkr5paq8hjttbo_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob4c5h2bs)**** Thank you so much for joining me in showing the Left that there are still Americans who will speak up for our constitutional rights! Gratefully, Jon Lizak Sophomore (Business Major) Binghamton University P.S. Friend,

Parents can't catch a break.

Since being home-bound in 2020, parents quickly learned just how indoctrinated the public school curricula can be.

Now, Disney and other corporations want to push an ideology through their media on your kids. There are increasingly few institutions of influence that have not been co-opted by crazies.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z623g2nk94a8ctqi82tab85ifrldtf52f5r1k7o8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

I saw the writing on the wall 10 years ago. That's why I created the _Tuttle Twins. _

The _Tuttle Twins_ is a book series that teaches children about free enterprise, private property rights, the Constitution, and the ideas of our Founding Fathers. There are no other children's books teaching these important topics.

I am on a mission to distribute 1,000,000 copies of the Tuttle Twins into the hands of homeschooled children, public schools, and libraries across the country.

[_**Can you give $10, $20, $50, or more to distribute Tuttle Twins to the rising generation? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3miqn9fdvqnu4o5p71tj2gi7voc08i3jffe753o_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

It costs roughly $10 to distribute one book.

**So far, over 3 MILLION copies of the Tuttle Twins have been distributed in 9 languages.**

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5mehmrf9tn4rc174v7ktr8ub6a6049fa1lv5i98_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

The solution won't come from the government or who we elect next. The solution is providing pro-family, pro-liberty content that you can trust and that your kids enjoy.

I've received hundreds of letters from kids saying how much they enjoy reading the Tuttle Twins. And the best part is a lot of these kids now have more knowledge in topics about inflation than our very own President Biden!

[**_Friend, can you join me and donate $10, $25, $50, $100, or more to the Tuttle Twins and help us fight back against woke corporations? Click here to donate >>_**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgitmhv2laa6bugu93boiu3nlmpgisjrdqj2ar3o_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

Here's how your support allows us to get books into the hands of families.
1. Homeschooled families or teachers who wish to teach these ideas will receive free copies of the Tuttle Twins.
2. Libertas Institute, the organization behind the Tuttle Twins, plans to distribute more copies to public schools and libraries, giving children an alternative to what is being taught now.
3. Once we raise enough money, our print manufacturers will work with Libertas Institute to ship out the books to those in need. [_**It costs roughly $10 to produce and ship each book. **_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zleiqgk37atcg0t6nqpubu87hd79qcg81ibkblk8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

[_**Donate 50 Tuttle Twins book for $500 Here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znqgdq7igo00l4e9qm2705kq66lpfum8chk80tq8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate 100 Tuttle Twins book for $1,000 Here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi9bonnbe1si0osee41g8125eokg4h1qadgmjo10_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjj60ob5c1h2bs)

You may have read about it in the news, or seen me talking about it with Tucker Carlson on Fox News. Right now, Twitter is holding our account hostage and demanding that we delete our "offensive" tweet in order to regain access. But I promise you - that's not going to happen. Instead, we're standing our ground. We're standing for the truth. And with Elon Musk now holding a sizable portion of Twitter's stock, it looks like our window of opportunity may be opening. It was our satirical response to USA Today's decision to name Dr. Levine their "Woman of the Year." Shortly after, I received an email from Twitter letting me know that they were locking the Babylon Bee team out of our account for violating their "hateful conduct" policy. Since then, a few of our editors have been locked out of their accounts. Tucker Carlson was locked out of his account after expressing support for us. Charlie Kirk received the same treatment.

And all of this backlash comes because we dared to state the truth: That Rachel Levine, a biological male, is not a woman. [**We will NEVER surrender to Twitter's woke agenda. And with Elon Musk becoming their largest shareholder, it looks like we may finally get the reprieve we've been looking for. But if he's going to use his new influence to take action, Elon needs to hear from millions of concerned Americans. Will you stand with us by signing the petition right now?**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMTA0LWE2ZGMzMjdjOTBmNDQ2YWI4YWU1ZDEzZDFhNGQzZGQwIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjQiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvcHI5enNmemhvbD9zcmM9RkZPMjY5MzgifQ/E45FsDLrTanfU-mYis2ykQ) Here's the good news - Elon Musk is a fan of the Bee. He has expressed his support for us in the past, and he was even a guest on our podcast last year. But that doesn't mean that our case is a slam-dunk. He has bylaws, legal constraints, policies, and other shareholders to think of. If we're going to stand any chance of getting his attention, we need to assemble _MILLIONS_ of concerned Americans, all urging him to stand up for free speech online by reinstating the Bee on Twitter. [**You can join that call now by signing the petition.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMTA0LWE2ZGMzMjdjOTBmNDQ2YWI4YWU1ZDEzZDFhNGQzZGQwIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjUiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvcHI5enNmemhvbD9zcmM9RkZPMjY5MzgifQ/_C-mEXxtDITuxe0Zra47jg) Right now, the Babylon Bee is paying the price for daring to speak the truth. Tomorrow, it could be you. But if we can get Elon in our corner, we can turn back the censorship offensive at Twitter and gain a major foothold in the fight to defend free speech online. Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. **But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today.**

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z74b9chh1pc8glgtg4529ubatuofo949de44onjg_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjgm2o75cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65stkc5qe5cbn6lj64pj0s1oe1cjgc9rb4sj0mhge5dtl6gr6ed72m5i34t3gc9jjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup32pjimsqr4ptnclj35c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
Joe Biden and the Democrats are at best fools, and at worst treasonous criminals intentionally destroying our country.day... | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6a8e9pks1b892lojo6kjvcue1akaui8tgnjip3g_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjgm2o75cjh2bs)
---

Fellow American,

We still have more than two years to go.

And if the Democrats keep control of Congress the entire nation could end up looking like a third world country by 2024.

That's why I'm running for Senate – [**and why I hope I can count on your support.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zujts5onba8uol7up83c4u0nfs050ckap714jr1o_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjgm2o75cjh2bs)

My name is Carla Sands. I was President Donald Trump's ambassador to Denmark, and I'm the only America First conservative running for United States Senate here in Pennsylvania.

Now, I don't know you and I don't know where you live.

_I don't know if you've ever even been to the great state of Pennsylvania._

**But I do know that the Democrats are pouring MILLIONS into this Senate race, because they know just how important it is.**

They know that swing states like Pennsylvania will decide the fate of our country for better or worse.

They know that one Senator from Pennsylvania could make all the difference.

One Senator from Pennsylvania could stop their radical Supreme Court Justice nominees.

One Senator from Pennsylvania could stop their job-killing Green New Deal.

One Senator from Pennsylvania could stop their ongoing attempts to overhaul our elections and commit undetectable fraud.

name: Ron Johnson
subject: I believe America is in peril. I need your support, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

Ron Johnson

| | Hey team, Sunday was National Siblings Day, which made me realize I should tell you a bit about my brother Kermit. The fact that he became a doctor wasn’t very surprising to any of us. Growing up, Kermit was always so excited to go with Mom on her rounds visiting patients, soaking in her nurse jargon, and watching how she cared for our neighbors. I’ve seen how those early years with Mom have made Kermit the doctor he is today — how deeply he listens, and how he can relieve a stressful situation with his calm demeanor or a good joke. You can be the smartest person on the planet, but being an elected representative requires more – we deserve leaders who care and know how to listen. I’ve also seen how hard Kermit advocates for his patients. Folks,
Nearly six months ago, I announced that I was running for Congress because we're in a moment where big change is possible right now.
I still believe that, and I know that together we can accomplish big things. That's why I've decided the best way our campaign can continue to serve Maryland and Prince George's County specifically is to make sure I can continue the important work I'm doing in Annapolis for the families I represent.
I still firmly believe that we have so much more we can accomplish. We need to make sure that we're not passing the problems of today on to future generations, and I’m committed to fighting for our home. Prince George’s and the State of Maryland need leaders for our future who are equipped to make the progress we need to see, both today and tomorrow ‐‐ whether that's in Congress, in the State House, in our counties, or in our municipalities.
Thank you to everyone who contributed to my campaign and to those who volunteered, knocked on doors, and sent texts. It means the world to me and our movement.
We are not done. There's so much more we can do. Maryland still needs you and needs the future we believe in.
Thank you,
Jazz
As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

Prince George’s and the State of Maryland need leaders for our future who are equipped to make the progress we need to see, both today and tomorrow ‐‐ whether that's in Congress, in the State House, in our counties, or in our municipalities. Thank you to everyone who contributed to my campaign and to those who volunteered, knocked on doors, and sent texts. It means the world to me and our movement. We are not done. There's so much more we can do. Maryland still needs you and needs the future we believe in. Thank you, Jazz As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son. | | Peter,

Matt Birk and I have travelled the state, forging strong relationships with delegates and activists! The broad coalition we are building will ensure success in November. This MOVEMENT that's been created can defeat Tim Walz.

**Here's the good news and bad news:**

**Good news:**
Tomorrow, quarterly reports will come out for each governor candidate. Our campaign will continue to show an unprecedented small-dollar fundraising pace for a Republican candidate: in _Q1 of 2022_ we raised **OVER** a _Quarter-Million dollar_ s. **Our report will show we can WIN.**

**As of today,** we have raised nearly $1.6 Million and have over $825,000 cash on hand. As of December 31st, we had more cash on hand than all other GOP governor candidates combined. _**These numbers matter**_** ** because it’s never been done before by a non-incumbent challenger (Republican OR Democrat). President Trump proved that the small dollar movement can be the engine behind a successful campaign. We’ve built that right here in Minnesota and can take the fight right to the DFL machine. We have not taken one dollar from big Tech or big Pharma, and we don’t intend to. We look to the small dollar folks for a never ending supply of energy that will bring conservatives a victory in November!

**Bad news:**
Far-left Tim Walz is doing exactly what we projected he'd do. He announced that he's raised [$1 MILLION](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=c8473e1c87&e=33b11688c1). We're not surprised by this. Democrats love to spend frivolously, and Tim Walz is no different. We don't care if we're outspent 4-to-1 or 40-to-1. Our movement and message will carry the day against his failed policies. [Can you help us? We are building a movement that can change the course of our entire state! Minnesotans are speaking in one voice: let's have safe streets; let's prioritize SCIENCE over political science; let's focus on STUDENTS instead of broken institutions and STOP the indoctrination; let's have secure elections.

Aren't you ready? Aren't you ready to secure freedom in Minnesota? [Let's continue this momentum](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=d8879f99ea&e=33b11688c1) and get behind a movement that can win!

Dr. Scott Jensen

subject: ICYMI: “How Secretaries of State Can Lead the Fight to Strengthen Democracy”
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Hi friend,
Last week, I wrote an op-ed in Democracy Docket about the critical role Secretaries of State play in making our democracy stronger, more inclusive and more representative. _“As a lifelong advocate and volunteer president of the NAACP’s Boston branch, I’m no stranger to fighting back when our civil rights are threatened. And as I think about the ways in which recent attacks on voting rights echo the poll taxes and jelly bean tests of the Jim Crow era, and threaten to exacerbate deeply entrenched inequities that have impacted BIPOC communities for generations, I keep coming back to the need for proactive, visionary state-level leadership.”_ Especially in “blue” states like Massachusetts, the status quo isn’t good enough - we need to be a beacon of what a strong, healthy democracy looks like.
And that means more than just the laws on the books, it means intentional, proactive efforts to give more people the information and opportunity to engage with our democracy.
_“The people of Massachusetts deserve a secretary who works in deep partnership with community to identify the most effective solutions for persistent barriers to voting; who fosters strong, supportive partnerships with local elections offices to make sure cities and towns have the information, technical resources, and funding necessary to administer safe, secure and accessible elections; who promotes a culture of civic participation where people see their own lived experiences and perspectives reflected in their government; and who advocates for voting rights policies and legislation that not only bring Massachusetts in line with our neighbors, but also push us ahead.”_
[You can read my full piece in Democracy Docket here](https://TanishaSullivan.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=85e18e2f1de926628891a3dbe&id=80cb78847b&e=dc6a14721a).
If you agree that “good enough” is not enough, and we need to engage people across Massachusetts not just on Election Day but every day, sign up to join our campaign and do just that.

body:
Enough is enough.
| | | |
---
---
"We felt they weren't necessary at the time. We have money, we have a surplus." MA House Speaker Ron Mariano
---
---
That's what House Speaker Ron Mariano said yesterday when asked why the Legislature is refusing to include any tax cuts as part of next year's state budget.
Friends, this is what we're up against.
In my candidacy for Governor, I am running against the extreme tax-and-spend policies Beacon Hill progressives - including my opponents - insist upon.
Inflation is at 8.5%, the highest rate in four decades. Consumer goods, gas, and groceries are all expensive. That translates into a pay cut for every Massachusetts resident.
And yet... despite the fact our state has a budget surplus on its hands, progressives are not just refusing to cut taxes, they're actually trying to push a tax increase for some residents on this year's ballot. You know my opponents in the race for Governor can't wait to get their hands on more of your money.
Enough is enough.
As your next Governor, I will fight hard for taxpayers and push back against progressives spending all your money.
We can't let the Democrats win this race. We need to take back our state.
Can I count on you for your support?

| Vernon Jones Takes the Victory at UGA Candidate Forum
---
| |
---
|
---
| Athens, Georgia (April 14, 2022) Yesterday, Vernon Jones stood out from the field at the 10th Congressional Candidate Forum hosted by the College Republicans at the University of Georgia. The event featured all but two of District 10's qualified candidates. The event featured questions from the audience with topics including but not limited to election integrity, the Ukraine-Russia conflict, and the state of the economy. Well-received by the audience, Vernon reiterated his commitment to the America First agenda, fighting the Radical Left, and taking on the GOP Establishment.
"It was an honor to join the UGA College Republicans last night. Those in attendance represent the future of America and I enjoyed the opportunity to share my vision for America as we navigate these increasingly perilous times," said Vernon Jones.
Vernon Jones' performance made it obvious as to why he is the only GA-10 candidate endorsed by President Donald Trump.

About Vernon Jones
---
| |
---
Vernon Jones is running for Georgia's 10th Congressional District. He is a former member of the GA House of Representatives (1993-2001, 2017-2021) and former Chief Executive Officer of DeKalb County, GA. A former Democrat, Jones officially switched parties in January 2021 after endorsing Donald J. Trump for President and speaking at the 2020 Republican National Convention. The proud Republican is now running in GA10, as a Pro-Trump candidate who will fight for free and fair elections, and always put Georgia and America First.
---

subject: You won’t hear this on Facebook
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWAkNz4H8N

As I'm sure you know, Facebook, Google, and other Big Tech
companies such as Twitter have chosen to become destructive of
core American principles...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWAkNz4H8N

Hello
Fellow Conservative,

I'm
sending you an email because I wanted to make sure this message
reached you.

As I'm
sure you know, Facebook, Google, and other Big Tech companies
such as Twitter have chosen to become destructive of core
American principles that sustain us as a free society.

They
censor and suppress conservative ideas. For example, approaching
the 2020 election Facebook recklessly concealed a major news
article from one of the nation's oldest newspapers simply because
it posed a risk to their narrative. And that's just one instance.
They've also suspended and de-platformed many conservative voices
in the last two years.

Heritage's own online team still has posts about election
integrity, religious freedom, conservative principles, and more
throttled online-with no clear explanation why.

By now
it's clear that Big Tech's ideological bias targets and censors
conservative voices, shrinks the marketplace of ideas, and
undermines the foundation of our republic.

At least
through email, I'm pretty sure my voice will reach you. And
that's why I'm asking you to stand with us.

Right
now, Heritage is strategically taking action to counter Big
Tech's bullying tactics.

You can
sign our Big Tech Petition to be a part of this fight by clicking
this link:

https://secured.heritage.org/sign-thf-big-tech-petition/

Heritage
has a strategy for stopping the Radical Left's agenda as
championed by Facebook, Google, Twitter, and others in Big Tech.

They are
giants. They are powerful. But their agenda can be stopped. And
with your help, it will be.

Join us
in standing against them by signing this petition today.

Thank
you, and all the best,

Kevin
Roberts, Ph.D.

President, The Heritage Foundation

The
Heritage Foundation 214 Massachusetts Avenue NE Washington
D.C. 20002

Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven't read the book, you know the name. It's _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we're working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America's greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, "****Mark Twain:**_**Tom Sawyer**_**,**_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** "](http://trk.readactnews.) Twain's realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as important as ever. Now, we have created a special DVD version of our course that includes all nine lectures. And today, [**I'd like to send you this DVD box set as our way of thanking you for supporting our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more**](http://trk.readactnews.-MuF8w).
---

202.738.9089**

# New public polls show Bill McSwain surging into 2nd Place
_New polls released by Eagle Consulting Group and Franklin & Marshall show Bill McSwain has risen to 2nd place behind Doug Mastriano_
**West Chester, Pa.** **\--** The McSwain for Governor campaign today shared that two new public polls, conducted by Eagle Consulting Group and Franklin & Marshall, have both confirmed that Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, has surged into second place among the GOP gubernatorial candidates.

The results are as follows:

Franklin & Marshall, in a sample of 785 registered Pennsylvania voters, including 317 Republicans, found:

Doug Mastriano 15%
**Bill McSwain 12%**
Lou Barletta 10%
Dave White 5%
Undecided 40%

Eagle Consulting Group, in a survey of 502 likely Republican primary voters reported:

Doug Mastriano 19%
**Bill McSwain 13%**
Lou Barletta 11%
Dave White 7%
Undecided 44%
---
| This strong momentum reflects the outpouring of support that McSwain has received across the Commonwealth from hard-working families who share McSwain's dedication to law and order, cutting the gas tax in half, and parents' rights in education.

McSwain is the only candidate who has continuously maintained an upward trajectory, and is the only candidate with the skills, resources, and background to defeat Josh Shapiro in November. McSwain raised $1.4M from donors in the first quarter of 2022, by far the highest reported of any GOP gubernatorial candidate.

McSwain campaign manager James Fitzpatrick had this to say about the poll results:
---
| **_"We are proud to have the support of conservative patriots from across the Commonwealth who share Bill's vision for a safer, freer, more secure Pennsylvania. Bill's growing strength among primary voters confirms that Pennsylvanians are ready to nominate a conservative outsider who will fight for them as Governor. A McSwain primary victory is just weeks away." _**
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=d632b41cb9&e=b1ec95759b)

name: Val Demings
subject: I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio
body:
Derek,
I'm Val Demings, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate to defeat Marco Rubio and win better, stronger leadership for the people of Florida.
Just 10,033 votes (0.12 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: I cannot win this without you.
That's why I'm asking you to become one of the donors to my campaign for Senate by splitting a contribution between me and CommonGood right now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_vd?refcode=20220414_CGVA_Demings]
Every dollar you can spare will help us build the strongest grassroots operation to defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority.
Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would.
Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district.
So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine.
The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice.
I stand on the side of our democratic institutions, on the side of everyday working Floridians – but I need your help to win this race. Will you split a contribution of $27 or more to CommonGood and me to defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_vd?refcode=20220414_CGVA_Demings]
In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society."
We're at an inflection point for our democracy that will decide if we live up to John Lewis' dream, Mike. The modern-day Republican Party is committed to the exact opposite of what Congressman Lewis stood for. Marco Rubio and Senate Republicans grow more extreme by the day, more committed to a dangerous, anti-democratic agenda. Putting party over the future of our democracy, over the wants and needs of Florida's working families.
You have my word, that when it comes to winning this race and delivering better leadership for Florida, I will fight like never before. Because when your friends and neighbors put their trust in you to be their voice, you work for them – and that's just not what we're seeing from Sen. Rubio. But it's only together that we'll have a shot at winning – so here's what I'm counting on: 6,112 donations, before 11:59 p.m. tonight. Are you in, Mike?
Split a contribution between CommonGood and me of $27 or more right now – whatever you can spare to fuel our battleground Senate race – so we can defeat Marco Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_vd?refcode=20220414_CGVA_Demings]

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being on my team.
—Congresswoman Val Demings

name: Peter Franchot
subject: BREAKING: Laura Neuman Endorses Peter Franchot for Governor
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I am deeply honored to have received the endorsement of former Anne Arundel County Executive Laura Neuman, who has just suspended her campaign for Governor. Laura’s story is inspiring. She overcame an incredibly difficult childhood in East Baltimore to become a thriving entrepreneur, a leading public servant, a champion for working families, and an advocate for women’s justice. She ran a strong campaign centered around the belief that every Marylander deserves a path to opportunity, and challenged her fellow candidates to champion solutions for those most vulnerable.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=20.22]
Laura, I can’t thank you enough for your trust and friendship. We share the commitment that we must continue to break barriers of inequity by building new bridges of prosperity where everyone is a part of the project. In the years to come, I look forward to partnering with you to create more jobs for Marylanders, invest in our public schools, lower the costs of healthcare and housing, and so much more. As Governor, I’ll be a champion for the underserved. I won’t let you down.
This latest endorsement is yet another testament to the growing strength of our inclusive, statewide coalition of support. I’ve already received the endorsements of over 100 current and former elected officials and labor unions – the most of any candidate for Governor – and recent polls consistently show that we lead the rest of the field by a strong margin.
This is an important moment for our campaign, and we need to make sure that it doesn’t go to waste. Fresh off the heels of this major endorsement announcement, will you chip in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to raise an additional $3,000 that will help us print more field literature and yard signs, run more ads, hire more organizers, and ultimately secure the votes we need to win this competitive race.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422]
With your help, we’re going to deliver on the concrete points of progress to lift our communities into the high quality of life that they deserve. From combating the student debt crisis, to making Maryland the first carbon neutral state in the nation, to leveling the economic, social, and political playing field for Black Marylanders, we have an exciting opportunity to redefine the promise and possibility of state government in the years ahead.
Enough talk. Let’s get it done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=20.22]
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/announcement041422?amount=20.22]

Right now, Republicans are doing everything they can to kick me off the ballot – but we are doing everything we can to fight back. Their meritless case rests on just a few signatures that had minor errors in the associated date. But Iowa law doesn’t state that signatures can be invalidated because of a missing date. They are literally making up reasons to silence the voices of Iowans and undermine democracy while spending thousands against us to do so.
Let's be clear here: this campaign has met every single requirement to be on the ballot for U.S. Senate. The Secretary of State’s Office affirmed it, and the bipartisan State Objections Panel affirmed it. I intend to be on the ballot and defeat Sen. You see, this is about so much more than a name appearing on a ballot. It's about fighting for working families. It's about getting better leadership after 47 years of Sen. name: Michael Robinson
subject: Doug will make Maryland a state of endless opportunity

As a first-generation college student whose mom was always working hard to make ends meet, even the thought of college was a bit daunting to me at first. But with Doug's guidance and support, I ended up earning my Bachelor's and MBA degrees at Yale, working at some really interesting places, and now, am working on a PhD.**** Doug always told me that he believed in me, that I could make it, and most importantly, that I could use my education and the opportunities it brought to help the communities that I care about. I'm excited about Doug's candidacy because he's committed to creating more opportunities for everyone to reach their highest potential. No matter a child's background, income, or home circumstances, they should be able to grow up in a safe environment and with the same opportunities to succeed as someone with a more privileged upbringing. _Too often that 's not the case._ Doug once said something that really stuck with me -- "there are a lot of Yale minds out there but not enough Yale opportunities." As Governor, Doug will make sure that more kids are given the opportunities and resources needed to achieve their dreams and make a change in their communities. That means it’s up to us, Peter . name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Thanks for everything
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress, www
body:
Dear Friend,

It was invigorating to spend the weekend with like-minded Pennsylvanians who are dedicated to making a REAL difference!

If you were able to make it to the virtual Keystone Progress Summit — Pennsylvania’s Progressive Summit — we were thrilled to see you there! It was an enriching weekend filled with thoughtful conversations, meetings with candidates, policy-makers, and experienced community partners, and so much more. For those of you who didn't make it, we know you were with us in spirit.

In his impactful keynote, the esteemed Maryland Congressman Jamie Raskin even announced the exciting news that there will be public hearings on the January 6 Commission no later than June. Other highlights included a lively discussion with the U.S. Senate candidates John Fetterman and Malcolm Kenyatta around gun control. We had a talk about abortion liberation with our partners from Pennsylvania Abortion Liberation+ (PAAL+) and the Pennsylvania Legislative Black Caucus explored ways to eliminate structural racism. Our workshops really served to fuel our movement around rural organizing, food justice, the youth vote, and more. We were honored to have all of you with us.

And this was just the beginning! We had so much to discuss that we’ll create an ongoing series of conversations to educate voters through the primaries. Also, please keep an eye out: In an upcoming email, we’ll soon be sharing videos from the Summit.

With threats to our democracy and rights coming at us in a flurry, now is the time to ramp up the fight. After this weekend I, for one, feel much better prepared to meet the challenges coming our way in the midterms and the many other critical battles we're facing here in PA.

Thank you for standing together with us!

Laura Nevitt
Keystone Progress

body:
A wave is building across the country. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44137850/340257850/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ4I_PRO_E_20220414_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYThlM2IxYS0yMmJjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rHOuEvXCPqyXuIbIOqPjSaTZkGRkRh-84doA_w6lmS0=&emci=a78e3b1a-22bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=aa8e3b1a-22bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
Something incredible is happening across the country. Working people are recognizing how much power they have when they come together — and they’re using that power to unionize workplaces across the country. Just look at Amazon, where a dedicated group of local organizers overcame union busting and beat Goliath by winning a union election in Staten Island — the first ever at any Amazon warehouse. Or school districts and hospitals across the country, where educators, nurses, and staff have been fighting for good pay, good benefits, and safe conditions for everybody. Or Starbucks, where workers are organizing all over the place, including two stores in the Boston area that just voted unanimously to become the first unionized Starbucks locations in the Commonwealth (woo-hoo!). I’m inspired by brave union organizers putting their livelihoods on the line to fight for each other and to fight for families across the country. I'd love to take a moment to share a few quotes from those Starbucks union organizers right after they won their elections in Boston last week — to help emphasize what this moment means:
* “McDonald's workers, if you're out there...you can do this. Wendy's, I'm looking at you — you can unionize. It's possible. And it seems impossible, but it's not.” - Maria
* “It’s been this huge domino effect....seeing more stores file [for union elections] is so empowering for us. And it kind of makes us want to win more, because we want to show up for our partners to say, ‘Hey, we're doing this, and we won, so you can too.” - Ash
* Responding to Starbucks CEO Howard Schultz, who recently asked a Starbucks union organizer, “If you hate Starbucks so much, why don’t you go somewhere else?”: **“Our partners, our coworkers, we're not just like friends — we are family...I don't want to leave that. That's not what this is about. I just found it so insulting. I love our regulars...So no, I don't hate Starbucks. Don't ever — don't ever say that. We don't hate it. This is pretty much all a lot of us have at this point.”** \- Maria

**When workers fight, workers win — and every union victory builds momentum for more wins and puts power in the hands of working people, where it belongs.** **But giant corporations are fighting back with some ugly union busting.** They’re firing union organizers, spreading disinformation at mandatory meetings, threatening workers, basically saying the sky will fall if anyone so much as whispers the word “union,” and more. But even if corporations get caught breaking the law, they often just get slaps on the wrist. If that. **So, we need to pass the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, which would hit union busters with tough new fines, clear the way for more workers to organize more unions, and be the strongest pro-worker law in decades. It’s already gotten through the U.S. House, and President Biden is ready to sign it.** [_**Unions built America’s middle class, and unions will rebuild America’s middle class. But we’ve got to keep raising our voices and get the PRO Act through the Senate to make it easier to form a union. Add your name if you agree: We need to fight union busting by passing the PRO Act.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44137851/340257851/1908970462?refcode=EMZ4I_PRO_E_20220414_V1S2&ms=EMZ4I_PRO_E_20220414_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYThlM2IxYS0yMmJjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rHOuEvXCPqyXuIbIOqPjSaTZkGRkRh-84doA_w6lmS0=&emci=a78e3b1a-22bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=aa8e3b1a-22bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) We can’t count on billionaire CEOs to support workers out of the goodness of their hearts. We need to demand real change — from picket lines to ballot boxes to the halls of Congress. I’m staying in this fight all the way. And, when we fight side by side, we make each other stronger. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth P.S. Remember: Don’t cross a picket line! Instead, join one. Working people are recognizing how much power they have when they come together — and they’re using that power to unionize workplaces across the country. Just look at Amazon, where a dedicated group of local organizers overcame union busting and beat Goliath by winning a union election in Staten Island — the first ever at any Amazon warehouse. Or school districts and hospitals across the country, where educators, nurses, and staff have been fighting for good pay, good benefits, and safe conditions for everybody. Or Starbucks, where workers are organizing all over the place, including two stores in the Boston area that just voted unanimously to become the first unionized Starbucks locations in the Commonwealth (woo-hoo!). I’m inspired by brave union organizers putting their livelihoods on the line to fight for each other and to fight for families across the country. I'd love to take a moment to share a few quotes from those Starbucks union organizers right after they won their elections in Boston last week — to help emphasize what this moment means: “McDonald's workers, if you're out there...you can do this. Wendy's, I'm looking at you — you can unionize. It's possible. And it seems impossible, but it's not.” - Maria “It’s been this huge domino effect....seeing more stores file [for union elections] is so empowering for us. And it kind of makes us want to win more, because we want to show up for our partners to say, ‘Hey, we're doing this, and we won, so you can too.” - Ash Responding to Starbucks CEO Howard Schultz, who recently asked a Starbucks union organizer, “If you hate Starbucks so much, why don’t you go somewhere else?”: “Our partners, our coworkers, we're not just like friends — we are family...I don't want to leave that. That's not what this is about. I just found it so insulting. I love our regulars...So no, I don't hate Starbucks. Don't ever — don't ever say that. We don't hate it. This is pretty much all a lot of us have at this point.” \- Maria When workers fight, workers win — and every union victory builds momentum for more wins and puts power in the hands of working people, where it belongs. But giant corporations are fighting back with some ugly union busting. They’re firing union organizers, spreading disinformation at mandatory meetings, threatening workers, basically saying the sky will fall if anyone so much as whispers the word “union,” and more. But even if corporations get caught breaking the law, they often just get slaps on the wrist. If that. So, we need to pass the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, which would hit union busters with tough new fines, clear the way for more workers to organize more unions, and be the strongest pro-worker law in decades. It’s already gotten through the U.S. House, and President Biden is ready to sign it.** We can’t count on billionaire CEOs to support workers out of the goodness of their hearts. We need to demand real change — from picket lines to ballot boxes to the halls of Congress. I’m staying in this fight all the way. And, when we fight side by side, we make each other stronger. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth P.S. Remember: Don’t cross a picket line! Instead, join one. And maybe bring some snacks. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 36 hours until our critical mid-month fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $250,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

Peter Willis,

President Biden promised to cancel student debt, and he needs to deliver. Americans need immediate relief and Democrats need to regain trust ahead of the midterms.

That’s why Our Revolution and Nina Turner marched on Capitol Hill last week with many activist organizations demanding the abolition of student debt.

In direct response to our pressure, the Biden administration again paused student loan payments — this time through August. The president can make it permanent with the flick of a pen, but it will take our outside movement to make it happen.

Bernie Sanders hosted a town hall on student debt last night, exposing the injustices Americans face in the pursuit of an education, a job, and a life of dignity. “Canceling student debt doesn’t take responsibility away from the student — it recognizes the impact that disinvestment in public higher education has had on the children of working-class Americans.”

This isn’t just the morally right thing to do, it would jumpstart our economy and help stave off a right wing wave in November. Borrowers have saved $200B since student loan payments were paused under Trump, and now Democrats are going to turn them back on right before the election?

Life is more expensive because incompetent Democrats are in power. The policy decisions of the left are directly responsible for the record inflation we are suffering through, and hardworking, middle-class families are paying the price.

The Senate would accomplish a lot more with Ted, which is why I have endorsed him for US Senator of North Carolina. | Ted stands for everything Republicans are supposed to believe in - secure borders, a balanced budget, pro-life, and the CONSTITUTION! I’m tired of Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi constantly trampling over our rights and freedoms with every move they make. Can you chip in something to get Ted Budd in the Senate? Your investment will yield more and more FREEDOM! body:
Everyone should have access to an affordable education.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=240%2E61531%2EDEf7KY)
Hello,
Student debt is a problem across the country—but it’s particularly bad in Vermont. Student debt is higher here—$31,000 a person—than the national average.
**Higher education is often the gateway to the American middle class.** In many industries, bachelor’s or even master’s degrees are required for entry level jobs. But as the price of college soars, Vermonters and people across the country are getting crushed by debt.
[**Everyone should have access to an affordable education—but people are going into debt simply for pursuing a degree. It’s time we made higher education available to all and delivered relief. Add your name right away if you agree, and let’s work to make it happen.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-cancel-student-loan-debt/?source=em_20220414_p_t_studentdebt&t=3&akid=240%2E61531%2EDEf7KY)
The pandemic has only made it harder for families to make ends meet. Canceling up to $50,000 of student debt would provide relief to millions, start to close the racial wealth gap, and quicken our pandemic recovery. President Biden has issued an emergency pause on federal student loan payments through August. But people can’t live and plan with short-term band-aids, they need long-term relief.
**We shouldn't be punishing students with a lifetime of debt for simply pursuing a higher education.** Peter’s been listening to Vermont students for years, and he’s heard about how they are forced into heavy debt to finish school.
That’s why he continues to work to make higher education affordable and reduce the crushing burden of student loan debt. He’s fighting to increase access to community college, make debt-free public college a reality for all, and reduce the burden of student loans. He’s fighting to solve the student debt crisis today and make sure we don’t have another one on our hands tomorrow.
And we need to fight by his side.
[**If you agree it’s time to deliver relief to millions of Americans and make sure everyone can get an education without getting crushed by debt, add your name right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-cancel-student-loan-debt/?source=em_20220414_p_t_studentdebt&t=4&akid=240%2E61531%2EDEf7KY)
Thanks for taking action,
Team Welch

| Former Cobb County Sheriff Neil Warren backs Jake
---
| For immediate release April 14th, 2022 [news@jakeevans.org](mailto:news@jakeevans.org) "Jake will always stand up for the brave men and women on the front lines." Former Cobb County Sheriff Neil Warren today encouraged Sixth District Republicans to vote for Jake Evans for Congress.
---
| |
---
|
---
| "In this race, there's no candidate I trust more to Back the Blue than Jake Evans, and that's the top reason I'm supporting him," Warren said. " From the beginning of his campaign, Jake has sought out police chiefs and sheriffs, not just to get their votes but also their guidance. Local law enforcement don't need a congressman who'll give them speeches; they need someone who'll listen and respond to their needs on behalf of public safety. Jake knows our government has no greater responsibility than keeping our families safe, and he'll always stand up for the brave men and women on the front lines." Jake praised Warren as a trusted leader on law enforcement issues. "Sheriff Warren served Cobb County with distinction for many years, and he kept our communities safe," Jake said. "As a member of Congress, I will always welcome input from police and sheriff's departments, and I will always have their backs. I know that those in law enforcement and voters trust Sheriff Warren's judgment, and I'm honored to have his seal of approval."

| | Friend,

In the past 6 months alone, over **one million** illegal aliens have entered our country. They are bringing drugs, worsening the drug epidemic, and causing crime to reach record levels.

**This crisis is out of control and it is destroying our country.**

Just over one year ago, we were building the Wall and had policies in place that kept our border secure and our country safe. Under the Radical Left Democrats, our border is the worst it has been in history.

Without a border, we are not a country. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris are ignoring the crisis and refusing to even go to the border._They are aiding and abetting the invasion of our country_. That is a dereliction of duty, and I will hold them accountable when I am elected to Congress. **[If you want to Finish President Trump’s Wall, Join My Team Today!](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=e2660153d4&e=598f6aa24c)** When I am elected, I will fight for border security every day and pledge to finish President Trump’s Wall.

Together, we can secure our border, deport all illegal aliens, and put America First. # **De Gregorio: After Kremlin Sanctions, Gottheimer Must Choose Between Conflicted Russian Business Interests and Constituents**

_Again calls for Republicans Pallotta and Schneiderman
to join him in Stock Ban pledge_
---
| **FAIR LAWN** – Today, Nick De Gregorio, a Marine Veteran - who served in Iraq and Afghanistan - and Republican Candidate for Congress in New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District, issued the following statement in response to [new reports](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=00bef1b54f&e=31104c58a7) that the Kremlin has issued retaliatory sanctions against incumbent Democratic Congressman Josh Gottheimer’s business interests in Russian companies.

“Josh needs to immediately decide what he cares about more: his reputation as the [most active day trader in Congress](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=0409afab0e&e=31104c58a7) or his representation of New Jersey families in the Fifth District. This perfectly illustrates the conflict of interest that we have been the _first and only_ candidate to [call out](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=3790897233&e=31104c58a7) among the Republican primary field: our elected representatives should not be in positions where their stock ownership makes them vulnerable to manipulation from hostile foreign powers or any other business interest. It’s long past the time for Josh to give up his stock portfolio and for my Republican opponents to do the same.” – Nick De Gregorio

| | Imagine having a medical emergency when the closest ER is over 60 minutes away, the ambulance service is short-staffed, and response time is delayed. Imagine having a sick child, but there are no physicians or hospital beds within an hour's drive of your community. What if there [**aren't enough nurses**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44130257/340230488/-1877509599?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTI0MGZmMy0wY2JjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=flbuS33nvOg9wlJ0h9HEE_SF1uVNHaUqSVpVRLCMAAY=&emci=7620bda1-0abc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=59240ff3-0cbc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) and other professionals to take care of you? Dr. Bob Lorinser says this is the reality facing too many citizens in the 1st District, and it's high time someone does something about it. "Unlike my opponent, I am willing to address these problems by working with local, state, and federal resources to implement final solutions," said Dr. Lorinser. "We have very successful models, but they need to be a funding priority. Jack Bergman's goal is to privatize healthcare completely, at the dire expense of rural care accessibility." Nineteen Michigan rural hospitals [**are at risk of closing**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44130258/340230489/266747014?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTI0MGZmMy0wY2JjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=flbuS33nvOg9wlJ0h9HEE_SF1uVNHaUqSVpVRLCMAAY=&emci=7620bda1-0abc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=59240ff3-0cbc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) because of financial losses and a lack of financial reserves. It could reduce the amount of rural care by over 30%. Yet, in 2021, [**Bergman voted against $4.9 million**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44130259/340230490/1196384439?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTI0MGZmMy0wY2JjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=flbuS33nvOg9wlJ0h9HEE_SF1uVNHaUqSVpVRLCMAAY=&emci=7620bda1-0abc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=59240ff3-0cbc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) in federal funding to Bay Mills Indian Community and Upper Great Lakes Family Health Center (UGL). The health centers successfully used the funds for staffing, personal protective equipment, screening, testing, and other battles against the pandemic. body:
Despite what people like Tucker Carlson tell you, there are not two sides to the story of Russia’s war on Ukraine.
#
Derek —
Despite what people like Tucker Carlson tell you, there are not two sides to the story of Russia’s war on Ukraine. It IS a story of good and evil. All you have to do is look at the massacre of civilians in Bucha, the missile strike on Kramatorsk railway station, or the countless other atrocities being committed by Russian forces across Ukraine to see it clearly.
Here is the truth:
I am just so tired of the lies and disinformation coming from the right on the war in Ukraine, and that is why I am doing everything I can to fight back on television and with anyone who will listen.
I am sick and tired of the far-right in this country cheerleading for authoritarians and driving up hyper-partisanship to divide us on matters as fundamental as war and peace. They undermined our ability to deter this conflict, and they have disrupted our efforts to help Ukraine. They have blood on their hands.
And I am sick and tired of Republicans in this country getting off without accountability for voting against impeaching former President Trump when he withheld hundreds of millions of dollars in military aid to Ukraine in an attempt to extort the announcement of a baseless investigation into Trump’s primary rival in the 2020 presidential elections, current President Joe Biden.
Donald Trump did that.
I heard the call.
And only one Republican voted against impeachment.
VoteVets has a critical role in fighting back against right-wing disinformation in this country and I am proud to fight alongside them. So I am asking:

Today, my husband stood to protect Florida’s most vulnerable – the unborn. Just moments ago he signed legislation to protect unborn babies from abortion when the child reaches 15 weeks of gestational age. Today’s bill signing cements his promise to protect every Floridian who cannot defend themselves.

In Florida, we believe in the sanctity of life, and as the parents of three children under 5, we know firsthand that each little life is a miracle from God.

Governor DeSantis is the most pro-life, pro-family governor in America, and the signing of this bill into law confirms that.

My husband and I are fighting together to ensure that from a baby’s first heartbeat, to their first doctor’s appointment, to walking into an elementary school for the first time that they should have every opportunity to meet their maximum potential.

Our Creator does not make mistakes. Governor DeSantis and I believe every life has value. “Before I formed you in your mother’s body I chose you. Before you were born I set you apart to serve me. I appointed you to be a prophet to the nations.” Jeremiah 1:5

I am thankful for the work that Governor DeSantis is doing to protect the unborn, promote fatherhood, and support our adoption and foster care systems, and I am proud to stand by him as he defends life in Florida.

God bless you and God bless the great state of Florida.

Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis
