[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vv-mnc-email?refcode=220105_FR_newyearnewemail_LOGO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vv-mnc-email?refcode=220105_FR_newyearnewemail_LOGO] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Our healthcare system is broken, and the 27 million Americans who do not possess access to adequate care is proof!
This is one of the many reasons why I felt compelled to run for Congress. I want to be one of the many voices in Congress that supports Medicare for All and fight for the healthcare needs of Virginia’s 8th Congressional District.
Virginia’s 8th is home to upper middle class families who have high quality care and access to world-renowned specialists, but our district also has hard-working middle class families who budget for life-saving insulin.
We have veterans who served our country who face backlogs in their system, family members who have taken on the role as primary caregiver on top of their full time jobs, and people who are forced to choose between grocery bills and essential medications to keep up with the rising pharmaceutical company profits.
The United States is one of the richest countries with a thriving economy, but privatized healthcare is bleeding the working class, veterans, and retirement communities dry. People are going bankrupt in order to seek treatment, sick individuals are forced to pay unaffordable prices for indispensable medicines, procedures, and care, and we feel trapped.
Additionally, healthcare is an honorable career path that is respected globally, but medical school and crippling debt go hand in hand, and I believe this should not be a factor in young doctors and specialists when they join the workforce. The cost of excessive tuition should not deter students who have the intelligence and work ethic to become our nation’s next generation of life-saving medical care workers.
Our district is diverse in demographics and background and healthcare is not a "one size fits all" solution. Healthcare is a human right, and our community deserves to have a voice in Congress in Virginia’s 8th.

clean_body: Can I count on you? Principled. Determined. Hard-working. Civil. Respectful. Honorable. Those are some of the attributes I think of when describing Alaskans... And those are the same attributes I strive to bring to the United States Senate each and every day. Even though the American people have made it abundantly clear \-- over and over -- that they want leaders who compromise and deliver solutions to the many issues facing our nation, I am being relentlessly targeted by both sides of the aisle for doing just that. In a midterm election year with a 50/50 Senate, every race is important. But some races are considered an absolute must-win for those of us who believe in a strong and functioning democracy. As soon as I announced I was running for re-election a big target was put on my back and outside special interests started flooding Alaska with attacks smearing my record... and me personally. Running for re-election in this contentious political environment is not for the faint-hearted, but I am Alaska-tough and ready to run a hard-hitting re-election campaign. With so much at stake for Alaska and our nation, I need to have you by my side! This is going to be my most difficult and expensive race yet (by far!). Hi Peter – In case you missed it, Sen. Marsha Blackburn (R-TN) mixed up the Constitution and the Declaration of Independence in her recent tweet. **[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44132911/340236433/311099802?refcode2=99704e31-12bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&&refcode=220414_urd_blackburn_i1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkzMDg1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk5NzA0ZTMxLTEyYmMtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=jjvaTlsZn3tH_C15MMOyqlqqDV0NeFrEeo3UrE1UxZ4=)** Like you, we learned about the Constitution in grade school – Blackburn must have skipped school that day. And if getting two of the most important documents in our country's history wrong wasn't enough, Blackburn also degraded Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson during her Supreme Court nomination hearings. Instead of asking Judge Jackson questions about her experience or judicial record, Blackburn asked Jackson to define the word "woman" and attacked abortion rights. **This is not how representatives are supposed to act.** No one should be wrongly appropriating our founding fathers' words – let alone using them in the halls of Congress against a person nominated to the Supreme Court. **But this is the future of the Republican party – misinformation, culture wars, and complete hypocrisy. It would almost be comedic if it weren't for the fact that Blackburn is a U.S. senator who represents almost 7 million people.** We need politicians in power who will fight for the rights of all Americans, not use anything they can to score political points. body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| Dear Fellow American,

Great news...Judicial Watch is on a roll!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58612&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)
---

On March 25th, a Maryland court ruled in favor of Judicial Watch's challenge to Maryland's congressional redistricting plan. In its ruling the court _permanently barred_ the "extreme" plan created by the Democratic-controlled Maryland legislature.

Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit on behalf of 12 registered Maryland voters who object to Maryland's 2021 congressional redistricting plan on the grounds that it is a partisan gerrymander that diminishes their rights to participate in free, fair elections for the U.S. Congress on an equal basis with other Maryland voters, in violation of the Maryland Constitution.

The court agreed and threw out the plan. In response, the Maryland legislature passed and the Maryland governor signed into law a new, more reasonable plan that better respects the rights of ALL voters.

This key Judicial Watch court victory against abusive partisan gerrymandering in Maryland could set a national precedent!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58612&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=)
---

And just one week later, on April 1st, a California court ruled unconstitutional the state's racial, ethnic, and LGBT quota for corporate boards of directors. The court granted Judicial Watch's motion for _summary judgment_ in its taxpayer lawsuit asking the court to declare the quota scheme unconstitutional under California's constitution.

The lawsuit was filed by Judicial Watch on behalf of three California taxpayers to prevent California from enforcing Assembly Bill 979. The bill requires that boards of directors of California-based, publicly held domestic or foreign corporations satisfy a racial, ethnic and LGBT quota.

This historic California court decision declared _unconstitutional_ one of the most blatant attacks in the modern era on constitutional prohibitions against discrimination. In its ruling, the court upheld the core American value of _equal protection under the law_.

At Judicial Watch, we work hard every day through the legal system...and as you can tell, we deliver real results!

We are tenacious, and we dig in for the long haul. To do that, [we rely on our members and supporters. In response, the Maryland legislature passed and the Maryland governor signed into law a new, more reasonable plan that better respects the rights of ALL voters. | | Hi Peter, What kind of future are you voting for this election?

The primary election is right around the corner–on May 17th–and ballots will be mailed out soon. There’s a lot at stake, including selecting candidates for governor.

Here at the **Oregon League of Conservation Voters** (OLCV), we endorse only the brightest environmental candidates–not only those who will fight for clean air and water and a clean energy future, but those who share our commitment to equity and racial justice as well.

That’s why OLCV is proud to endorse **Tina Kotek for Oregon governor**. Tina is a proven fighter for the climate, and will be ready to lead on day one. As the former Speaker of the Oregon House, Tina has been behind every climate victory in the last seven years, and, as governor, she’ll continue to lead Oregon away from fossil fuels and toward a brighter future. Tina cares deeply about justice and equity, and we have no doubt that she’ll accomplish big things as Oregon’s next governor.

Check out **olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements** for a list of pro-environment candidates like Tina who care deeply about environmental justice and climate action–candidates who are running in order to truly make a difference.

Another way to get involved is to sign up to volunteer for OLCV. You can help get climate candidates elected by knocking on doors, phone banking, writing letters to the editor, and more.**[Sign up here to volunteer for OLCV!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44134853/340245327/-600427321?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjY5YjgzLTE4YmMtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TJK0OGVQIeZm_VzzAW_cswKrGUc5lzCfns5f0kEt1HU=&emci=5cc1ba48-b1ba-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b8b69b83-18bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**

If you’re new to the OLCV community, here’s a little more about what we do:
* We help elect **pro-environment candidates** in every primary and general election.
* We hold legislators accountable for their environmental track records using our **legislative scorecard**.
* During Oregon’s legislative session, we fight to make sure that **pro-environment bills** pass and that anti-environment bills never make it out of the capitol.

You can learn more about us on the [**mission page**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44134855/340245329/-432655304?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjY5YjgzLTE4YmMtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TJK0OGVQIeZm_VzzAW_cswKrGUc5lzCfns5f0kEt1HU=&emci=5cc1ba48-b1ba-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b8b69b83-18bc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) on our website. We hope you’ll join us in fighting for a better future this election season! Thank you,

Lindsey Scholten
Deputy Director, OLCV |

clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | Hi Peter, What kind of future are you voting for this election? The primary election is right around the corner–on May 17th–and ballots will be mailed out soon. There’s a lot at stake, including selecting candidates for governor. Here at the Oregon League of Conservation Voters (OLCV), we endorse only the brightest environmental candidates–not only those who will fight for clean air and water and a clean energy future, but those who share our commitment to equity and racial justice as well. That’s why OLCV is proud to endorse Tina Kotek for Oregon governor. Tina is a proven fighter for the climate, and will be ready to lead on day one. As the former Speaker of the Oregon House, Tina has been behind every climate victory in the last seven years, and, as governor, she’ll continue to lead Oregon away from fossil fuels and toward a brighter future. Tina cares deeply about justice and equity, and we have no doubt that she’ll accomplish big things as Oregon’s next governor. Check out olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements for a list of pro-environment candidates like Tina who care deeply about environmental justice and climate action–candidates who are running in order to truly make a difference. Another way to get involved is to sign up to volunteer for OLCV. You can help get climate candidates elected by knocking on doors, phone banking, writing letters to the editor, and more. If you’re new to the OLCV community, here’s a little more about what we do: We help elect pro-environment candidates in every primary and general election. We hold legislators accountable for their environmental track records using our legislative scorecard. During Oregon’s legislative session, we fight to make sure that pro-environment bills** pass and that anti-environment bills never make it out of the capitol. You can learn more about us on the on our website. We hope you’ll join us in fighting for a better future this election season! Dear Fellow Patriot,

Earlier this week, pro-gun Americans stood at the forefront of a political fight of colossal proportions as President Biden spoke from the Rose Garden, announcing the next phase of his gun control scheme.

**[Before you read on, please make a generous contribution to stop Biden's gun ban immediately](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze4dk0l4uuc4u14ik7v03eeisud8cevnmqliql0g_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjjm8p74c3h2bs)**.

The President has announced a sweeping 5-point assault on your Second Amendment Rights.

**1._Codifying the ATF 's Unconstitutional Ban on home crafted firearms_**:

Despite the massive backlash from law abiding gun owners, Biden is expected to order the bureaucrats at the ATF to bypass Congress and ban so-called "Ghost Guns."

The National Foundation for Gun Rights has been preparing for this moment for months and is ready to take the gun grabbers to court.

**That 's right, NFGR will work to file a lawsuit against the unconstitutional ban on home crafted guns**!

**2._Officially nominating Steve Dettelbach to become the permanent director of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF)_** :

It's clear Biden is bypassing Congress altogether in order to achieve his gun control agenda.

More and more he is simply directing his gun control enforcement agents at the ATF to do his dirty work.

Which is why Biden is absolutely determined to place a gun control true believer permanently atop the ATF.

And Dettlebach is just that.

_Dettlebach is outspoken in support of Biden 's gun control agenda including Universal Gun Registration and bans on so-called "Assault Weapons_."

He even earned himself the endorsement of Bloomberg's Everytown for Gun Control during his failed Ohio Attorney General campaign.

**3._Demanding licensed firearms dealers stockpile and hand over YOUR gun records_** :

You and I both know Biden and Gun Control Inc. have the ultimate goal of an Australian-Style gun confiscation.

And the first step toward that endgame is to establish a national registry of every firearm in America.

_With this new rule, gun dealers would be required to store purchase records indefinitely or hand them over to Biden 's goons at the ATF_.

**4._Spending more taxpayer dollars to fund gun control bureaucrats_** :

Biden wants to make sure that his gun control enforcement agents have plenty of funding to carry out his anti-gun orders.

As you know, the ATF's budget has dramatically increased each year for more than two decades, but that isn’t enough for Joe.

The fact is, Biden wants to beef up the ATF with unlimited resources so they can enforce whatever unconstitutional schemes they wish.

**5._Calling on Congress to pass more gun control_** :

While the President doesn't feel the need to go through Congress to dismantle the Second Amendment, he still would love if they threw him a bone and sent some more draconian gun control legislation to his desk.

We've successfully stalled Biden's agenda in Congress thus far. His so-called "Assault Weapons" Ban has gone nowhere, and his Universal Gun Registration bill (H.R. 8) is stuck in the Senate.

But that isn't stopping Biden from giving these ridiculous policies a nudge.

**So what can gun owners do to fight back**?

**[First and foremost, every gun owner needs to please make a generous contribution to stop Biden's gun ban immediately](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3rfu4qo7m6r77rrpfrmuttbl4hericb7gn67798_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjjm8p74c3h2bs)**.

Rest assured, your National Association for Gun Rights is launching a full-scale political counter offensive against Biden and Co.

And our legal foundation is already set to sue over the unconstitutional homemade gun ban.

But all these operations are extremely costly.

So the number 1 thing pro-gun patriots can do to fight back against Biden's gun grabs is to donate to the National Association for Gun Rights.

**[Please click here to fund the fight by making your most generous contribution today](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt14cn2ehjvutjdn932grg44h3r9f3epnh53mjl8_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjjm8p74c3h2bs)**.

With your generosity and activism, we are ready to smack down every one of Biden's gun grabs.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

P.S. Earlier this week, President Biden announced a sweeping new gun control offensive from the White House Rose Garden.

Gun bans, a new anti-gun ATF Director nominee, and a massive gun registration scheme were all announced.

**[Please make a generous donation to NAGR to ensure that the good guys have the necessary resources to effectively fight back](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zidvo7hqkc2pobuulbfuu59cs801mmm4a05kqo00_rp22sh2s8i66ob4sjjm8p74c3h2bs)**.

Flash forward 61 years later, in 2022, **82-year-old Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the House,** and the average age of the 116th Congress is 58 years old.

Most of Congress is years removed from raising a family, trying to buy a home, or even trying to make ends meet at the end of the month. For some, it's been decades since they've had to apply for a real job. **We need Members of Congress who understand modern American struggles, because they are living in modern America. We need term limits.**

clean_body: The 60-somethings in the House don't understand the real world in 2022 | Peter - This is a picture of Nancy Pelosi and President John F. Kennedy at his inaugural ball. It was taken on January 20, 1961, and Nancy is 20 years old. Flash forward 61 years later, in 2022, 82-year-old Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the House, and the average age of the 116th Congress is 58 years old. Most of Congress is years removed from raising a family, trying to buy a home, or even trying to make ends meet at the end of the month. For some, it's been decades since they've had to apply for a real job. We need Members of Congress who understand modern American struggles, because they are living in modern America. We need term limits. Members like Pelosi, who have been in office for nearly four decades, don’t understand the struggles of everyday Americans. We need fresh new voices. I care about the next 20, 30, 50 years of our Nation, the costs we pass to future generations, and what inflation is doing to young families and the elderly. But I don't think the Left is looking past sundown tonight. Peter, Democrats have taken America for granted and made it almost impossible for young people to get by. While they screamed about helping the working class, they sent our jobs to China, printed endless amounts of cash, and made healthcare and gas unaffordable. This Nation needs term limits in the House because this nation needs fresh voices to set it back on course. Thank you, Amanda Makki Conservative Republican for FL-13 | | Amanda Makki is an America First candidate for Congress in Florida's 13th District. The FirstEnergy bribery scandal might be the biggest in state history, but the pieces of the puzzle look just like every other scandal Republicans have pulled us into. It comes down to the same story: Ohio’s leaders putting personal profit above anything else. If elected governor, I have a plan to stop that from happening ever again. We need to invest in our ethics commission, pass anti-corruption legislation, and take the power to investigate politicians out of the hands of politicians and giving it back to the people. = Onward, Nan Whaley **= Paid for by Friends of Nan Whaley PO Box 2815, Dayton, OH 45401 This campaign is powered by supporters like you, but if you'd like to unsubscribe, .

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Need your feedback on this

body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=PAg17GWMuvgz95TSLLckhYYJRSJoa3vK&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
I was proud to cast a vote to confirm Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson to the highest court in our land. Her brilliance, perseverance, unwavering commitment to the law, and deep understanding of the justice system's impact on people's lives will all make her a superb justice.
Judge Jackson's confirmation will not only make the Supreme Court look more like America but also think more like America. Yet, while this confirmation was a joyous and glass-shattering outcome, I couldn't help but be appalled by the behavior of some of my Republican colleagues on the Senate Committee on the Judiciary during Judge Jackson's confirmation hearings.
They interrupted her. They berated her. They accused her of things that were blatantly untrue and incendiary. They cared less about the health and future of the Court and our nation than about their own Twitter feeds and public posturing.
If Republicans flip even a single Senate seat in this election, they will be back in control of the chamber - and back in a position to stop all future Biden nominees in their tracks. **That 's why I'm writing to you today to get your feedback on the issues that are important to you. Your feedback is critical to ensuring I can protect my Democratic seat and keep Democrats in control of the Senate.**
**[My team and I put together this brand-new priorities survey for April. Will you click here to let me know what's top of mind for you as we approach this must-win election?](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-april-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1164-su-nd)**
This election is absolutely crucial, and winning hinges on having a strategy that's connected to grassroots supporters - people like you. Thanks so much for taking the time to leave your input.
Dick

Last month, Republicans in the House passed the legislative branch budget. And despite the fact that they are part-time legislators already making more money than the average full-time Kentucky worker, Republican legislators voted to give themselves a raise.

While Republicans slipped in a pay increase for themselves, they voted against giving our hard working teachers a raise and against raising the minimum wage. **This is unacceptable.**

**That's why Andy took a stand and vetoed this pay raise for legislators – including himself.**

Republicans have once again shown they're not on the side of our children and educators. Their vote against raises for teachers comes after they tried to pass a harmful tax break that would reduce local and school tax revenues by $2.5 million annually.

| Summer of 1776 is BACK at Starshine Texas on Saturday, July 2nd. Early bird discounts are available NOW for General Admission and VIP Packages. Early bird ticket quantities are limited so don't wait to join the ultimate Independence Day celebration.

| FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is Summer of 1776? Summer of 1776 is Congressman Dan Crenshaw's annual Independence Day Celebration and the most patriotic party in America. A salute to all the things that make America the greatest country on Earth to LIVE FREE AND PARTY: live music, fireworks, family games, swim activities, festive food, and ice-cold drinks. This year, we're bringing the celebration to Starshine Texas - a 25-acre outdoor, recreational venue located in the heart of Humble, Texas. Starshine is home to a hillside concert arena, a lake, picnic areas, a luxurious clubhouse, and a playground for children. What to expect? Doors open for General Admission ticket holders at 4:00pm. Enjoy the family-friendly games and swimming activities, food trucks, and cash bars with beer and patriotic refreshments available for purchase. Attendees may bring their own lawn chairs and shade umbrellas and claim a spot in one of the designated areas near the concert stage or utilize the limited number of first-come, first-serve picnic tables. All General Admission areas are outdoors - shady areas, cooling misters, and tents will be around for folks who want a break from the Sun. VIP ticket holders will have access to the indoor clubhouse (see below for more information about VIP tickets). The live concert begins at 5:30pm with our opening band (to be announced soon). At 7:00pm, chart-topping country music singer Chris Janson - with hit songs like "Buy Me A Boat", "Good Vibes", and "Fix A Drink" \- takes the stage for an all-American show country music performance. At 8:30pm, the epic fireworks show commences. Following the end of the fireworks show around 9:00pm, we will have a nighttime DJ show for everyone who wants to dance and keep the good times rolling! What do VIP tickets include? In addition to access to all General Admission areas, VIP ticket holders have access to the indoor, air-conditioned clubhouse with first-come, first-serve lounge and table seating, a catered buffet, a cash bar with premium beer, wine and cocktails, and clubhouse balcony views of the concert stage. VIP ticket holders also receive early access to the venue beginning at 3:00pm (General Admission ticket holders may enter beginning at 4:00pm). VIP tickets are extremely limited and must be purchased in advance of the event. For questions about VIP tickets, please email us at events@crenshawforcongress.com or call 281-888-4016. Are children allowed to attend Summer of 1776? All ages are welcome! Our children's play area has a lot of fun games and activities to keep them entertained. However, after the fireworks show ends around 9pm the nighttime DJ show will be loud and better suited for the 21+ crowd. Do children have to pay to attend? Children under the age of 10 may attend for free but they must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Please enter the number of children under the age of 10 accompanying you in the checkout form on Eventbrite. Everyone else must pay the full ticket price for General Admission or VIP. What is the registration process like? Simple! General Admission (GA) and VIP tickets are available for purchase at our Eventbrite link. Eventbrite will email your tickets. Please save your tickets and bring them to the event. We will scan your ticket's QR code to verify it and you'll be given a GA or VIP wristband. The wristband will allow you to come and go from the event as you please. If you lose your ticket or have any questions, please email us at events@crenshawforcongress.com. What's the parking situation like? Park for free at our nearby offsite parking location (to be announced soon) and ride one of the complimentary, air-conditioned shuttles to Starshine Texas.
Parking will not be available on-site at Starshine Texas.
What is the shuttle service schedule? Shuttles will begin running from the offsite parking lot to Starshine at approximately 2:40pm. Expect shuttle buses to run between Starshine and the parking location approximately every 5 - 7 minutes. These times are subject to change.
Can we use Uber or another rideshare service to reach Starshine?
Yes! We highly recommend using a rideshare service. We will have a designated zone at Starshine for ridesharing and anyone who wants to be picked up/dropped off by a friend or relative.
Will there be seating? Summer of 1776 is a festival-style celebration. Lawn seating is first-come, first-serve with the event being standing room only. If you want to get comfortable on the lawn, we recommend bringing your lawn chair and/or picnic blanket. A limited number of outdoor picnic tables will be available first-come, first-serve for General Admission ticket holders. VIP ticket holders will have access to the VIP Clubhouse with a limited number of first-come, first-serve tables and lounge seating.
Are pets allowed at Starshine Texas?
Starshine Texas does not permit pets on property. Exceptions are made for registered service animals.
Can I bring my own food and alcohol?
Outside food and beverages are not allowed in Starshine Texas. General Admission ticketholders will have access to a variety of food trucks along with cash bars serving beer and non-alcoholic refreshments. VIP ticketholders will have access to the catered buffet inside the Clubhouse.
Are firearms or weapons permitted at the event?
All weapons, including concealed firearms, are prohibited at this event and on the premises of Starshine Texas. Off-duty police officers will be providing security at the event and all visitors must pass through metal detectors to enter the premises.

For all other questions, please email us at [events@crenshawforcongress.com](mailto:events@crenshawforcongress.com) or call 281-888-4016.

Dear Supporters, I NEED Your Help!
Facebook and Twitter have been Shadow Banning us: We have over 90,000 Followers between Facebook and Twitter and our posts are getting between 30 and 200 likes? I have asked friends of mine if they saw this post or this tweet and they said they haven't. This is happening over and over again.: ShadowBannned Accounts that are shadowbanned are put into a kind of invisible mode. In other words, they become a "shadow" that no one can see. Shadowbanning is when your posts or activity don't show up on a site, but you haven't received an official ban or notification.
I'm not absolutelty sure why they are ShadowBanning us, so I need your help to fix this!
How can you help? As my supporter, you can help by clicking on our page links for Facebook and scrolling through the first 10 posts that you see, Like, Share, and then Comment on each one. You can do the same on Twitter. Then we will monitor the posts and see the changes it makes on our reach. You can also change your following to Favorite from default to see if that will help as well.
Don't let Big Tech stifle my voice. We have to get our message out to Pennsylvanians and I need my core Grassroot team to do that. And that is you. Will you help and volunteer for this project? Here are the links:

Shadowbanning is when your posts or activity don't show up on a site, but you haven't received an official ban or notification. I'm not absolutelty sure why they are ShadowBanning us, so I need your help to fix this! How can you help? Team,
We have a common phrase here on Team Slotkin: the earlier, the better .
That’s why we’re emailing you 7 months away from Election Day. Contributions you make now allow us to be strategic and plan the essentials, months ahead – like reserving airtime on TV for advertising, digital advertising, and stocking up on yard signs, bumper stickers, and campaign literature.
It also lets us think outside the box. Like in 2020, when having face-to-face conversations with voters was nearly impossible. Team Slotkin purchased advertisements on video screens at gas pumps, allowing Elissa to reach folks as they were doing one of the few activities outside their homes.
Here’s why early investments matter: in the spring, TV stations open up their ad time for the fall. The earlier we make our reservations, the better inventory we get – aka the time slots where we’re guaranteed to get the most eyeballs.
Plus, the laws of supply and demand drive prices up: as more candidates are looking to reserve ad time, the more expensive it gets.
So, those early funds actually SAVE us money in the long run. That’s why we’re asking: will you chip in to help pave the way to victory in November? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220414&amount=28]

# Hillary Clinton, Biden, and Wolf Donors Flock to Dave White
_White's pre-primary cycle 1 fundraising comprised primarily of Union PACs and Wolf, Shapiro, DNC donors _
**West Chester, Pa.** **\--** The McSwain for Governor campaign today shared that funding reports released by the White campaign show that Dave White is heavily supported by Union PACs who have also given to Josh Shapiro, Tom Wolf, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden.

Excluding self-funding, Dave White raised $768,531 in Q1 2022. Of this, 49%, or $374,000, was from Union PACs. These **same** PACs have donated:
* $2,146,158 to Josh Shapiro and Tom Wolf since 2014
* $2.5M to Hillary Clinton
* $8M to Democrat groups since 2015, including donations to the DNC to help elect Joe Biden in 2020

---
|
---
|
---
| McSwain campaign spokesperson Rachel Tripp had this to say about the report:
---
| _**"Liberal Democrats have flocked to Dave White because he reflects their values - bigger government and higher taxes. A candidate's supporters reflect his priorities, and White's priorities resonate with Clinton, Biden, Shapiro, and Wolf donors, who know that they can rely on White to protect their interests." **_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **

– In a February 14, 2022 interview with Chris Stigall, Dave White said that Pennsylvanians have “accepted” the gas tax. He also has a history of supporting the gas tax during his time as a Delaware County Councilman.

- In 2017, White was exposed for raising property taxes and for pocketing $10 million in government contracts.

\- In 2014, the all-Republican Delaware County council, of which White was a member, voted to raised taxes by 2.8% to pay for a $20.4 million spending increase

Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [The Founders Vindicated](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQzioqyskyz-hADuXkXng94HGE45bfoB5FrY192qHub8lK8Yw&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=apr14_final&n=1) With the April 29 committee deadline approaching, the student vaccine bill, SB 871, has not been set for a hearing. And support is cratering. Even the radical school board in Berkeley just declined to endorse it. If the bill does not advance, which appears likely, I’m calling on Newsom to withdraw his own K-12 mandate immediately. When James and I [sued Newsom](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziopef_gk3HgrZHlL4qO7ZjXtrJdKUQ2jxrbAmcFXim8QG1d4daQL_tbUJFWA5OtORtNb6NOcwoZjOv3J1dIiuSZz&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=apr14_final&n=2) on June 10, 2020, the issue was separation of powers. We believed if COVID policy went through the Legislature as the Founders intended – even our wayward Legislature – there’d be less damage than one-man rule. Two years later, the fate of the “Vaccine Work Group” bills is vindicating this belief:
* AB 455: vaccine passport. **Defeated**
* AB 1102: employer mandate. **Defeated**
* AB 1993: employer mandate. **Defeated**
* SB 1864: police defunding. **Twice withdrawn**

Meanwhile, we’ve now learned that the two recent Sacramento mass killings involved a man protected by the Sanctuary State and a man released early from prison. Yet Newsom, just back from vacation, only wants to talk about more gun laws. My bills addressing the real problems will be heard next week. The Sanctuary State repeal is on Tuesday, followed by a new vote to overturn Prop. 47. We’ll also be forcing another up-or-down vote on the gas tax. Yesterday, we launched our first TV and digital ad buy...
#

Hey y'all -
Yesterday, we launched our first TV and digital ad buy to reach voters across North Carolina.
I’ll be honest: Going up on air this early wasn’t originally a part of the plan, but after talking it through with my team, I believed it was important to start reaching voters now.
And truthfully, I’ve learned that approach straight from Cheri. I’ve heard her say countless times that we cannot rely on the old playbook of waiting until right before Election Day to engage with the voters of North Carolina.
And, you know what, I agree. You don’t go from Public Defender to the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina by playing it safe.
Spending money on ads this early undoubtedly carries risk. But, Cheri and I made the bet that if we reached out and explained why it was so important, enough people would come through and help us fill the budget gap. So can we count on you?

name: Jane Hope Hamilton
subject: The voters of TX-30 deserve a debate.

body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
https://fb.watch/cobY1Jy0Vw/ [https://fb.watch/cobY1Jy0Vw/]
Friends,
Today, community leaders and I held a press conference [https://fb.watch/cobY1Jy0Vw/] calling on my opponent Jasmine Crockett to stop hiding and agree to public debates.
Why won't she debate me? Is it because:
She has a failed record as a legislator: Jasmine Crockett brags about being an effective legislator, but the facts are she did not pass a single bill in Austin. What's also true is that she failed to vote against the Republican voter suppression bill.
She's selling CD-30 out from under us: Crockett welcomed $2 million from billionaires in the Bahamas. Just two years ago, she criticized her statehouse opponent for raising $250,000 in contributions, saying that money didn't come from in-district donors. Now she's okay with $2 million from the Bahamas.
She ignores our constituent's needs : Crockett is one of the ONLY Texas State Representatives that doesn't have a district office.
She misrepresented her career as an attorney: Crockett has lied about representing Botham Jean's family. I am appalled she would brazenly lie and use the family's pain for political gain. She has yet to make a public apology.
Friends, we deserve better than this.
I am calling on my opponent to stop hiding and agree to public debates. Let's sit down with the members of our community and talk about our record and our plans for TX-30. The voters of our district deserve to hear our stances on the issues.
Regardless of whether she chooses to debate, I will continue to reach voters and share my strong record of delivering results for North Texas families. With just 32 days before the start of early voting, I need your help to make sure we leave no voters behind.
Would you please consider donating $10 today to help share our message with the voters of TX-30?

name: Charles Booker
subject: Are you tired of the political games, Peter?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

For too long, there's been this myth that Kentucky will forever be a red
state. But the truth is that Kentucky is a disenfranchised state.

Kentucky is a Commonwealth where a whole lot of people haven't felt heard
in a long time. Where the number of people who don't vote outnumber those
who do. Where voters holding marginalized identities have a harder time
casting a fair ballot than those who don't.

Republicans know this, so their plan is to continue dividing us,
distracting us from the common bonds we share, and discouraging us from
voting. Every year.

But we can change that this year by mobilizing our grassroots coalition to
beat Rand Paul. This campaign’s momentum is stronger than ever, but we
have a lot of work to do between now and Election Day, starting with our
primary election in a few weeks.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220414?refcode=em20220414-1761&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&refcode2=1761_346206_FxAvdB&akid=1761%2E346206%2EFxAvdB ]That's why today, we’re announcing our goal of raising an additional
$30,000 before our mid-month deadline on April 15 (tomorrow!) Every dollar
you give directly funds our ability to do voter outreach, close the voter
registration gap in Kentucky, and train organizers. Will you chip in?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220414?refcode=em20220414-1761&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1761_346206_FxAvdB&akid=1761%2E346206%2EFxAvdB ]Contribute $5 →

Regular people are fed up and tired of being ignored. We are done with the
days of politicians like Rand Paul exploiting us and making a mockery of
our lives.

I am ready to give Kentucky something new this November. But beating Rand
Paul will require significant resources and funding. And with only weeks
until our primary election, there isn't much time to lose.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220414?refcode=em20220414-1761&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1761_346206_FxAvdB&akid=1761%2E346206%2EFxAvdB ]That's why it's so important we raise an additional $30,000 before our
mid-month deadline tomorrow so we can turnout a record number of
Kentuckians in this election and out-organize Rand Paul. Will you chip in?

If we stand together, we can deliver bold change for Kentucky.

Together,

Charles Booker

If you support the way Joe Manchin-type Democrats are shutting down important legislation in the Senate...

body:
We’re in the final stretch and we still have a lot of work to do. That’s why we’re launching our Finish Line Fund two weeks before early voting starts.
#
Hey, **we’re just 2 weeks away from the start of in-person early voting** , and voters will be casting their ballots on who’s the best Democratic candidate to represent NC-01.
Our current House Democratic majority is hanging by a thread, and with corporate Democrats holding up progress — _we can’t emphasize how critical it is that we send a real champion for working people like Erica to Congress._
**That’s why we’re launching our Finish Line Fund** — and our first goal is to raise $20,000 before midnight tomorrow to ensure we have the necessary resources to call voters, knock on doors, run digital ads, and print campaign literature. ****
[**_Can you chip in $5 now to help us meet our $20,000 Finish Line Fund goal in the final stretch before early voting begins in NC-01?_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49000?t=1&akid=1088%2E3698%2EZfHfTh)
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49006?refcode=em20220414-1088&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1088%2E3698%2EZfHfTh)**
We’re not only up against corporate Democrats. We’re fighting back against Sandy Smith — our Trumpist, insurrectionist, and well-funded far-right Republican opponent.
Sandy Smith has the backing of Madison Cawthorn, Roger Stone, **and more of the far-right** which means she has access to a huge Republican war chest.
In the next 2 weeks we still have to ensure that our message reaches every corner of the district. And we depend on a steady stream of grassroots donations to do that.
[**_If you’re able to spare anything, can you make a contribution today to help support the Finish Line Fund? Every donation we receive between now and our primary election will have a tangible immediate impact on our movement._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/49000?t=21&akid=1088%2E3698%2EZfHfTh)
Thank you for your support,
Erica Smith HQ

| | Team, Sonia’s favorite part of running for Governor is hitting the road and meeting Bay Staters where they’re at. And recently, we spent some time in Western Massachusetts, and want to take a minute to share the highlights. We started off the trip — in true Sonia fashion — with a visit to Granny’s Baking Table. Sonia’s been a fan since we kicked off our campaign last summer, and the trip wouldn’t have been complete without stopping by. At Arise for Social Justice, Sonia was able to talk to the team about the important work they’re doing to support communities and fight for social justice in Springfield.
The folks over at Enlace de Familias have been doing crucial work to empower Holyoke residents and provide needed food, housing, and education assistance for families. We were grateful to meet with and hear from them firsthand about the services they provide. Pregnant and parenting young mothers with low incomes deserve a high-quality education just like their peers — from high school to college. Organizations like the Care Center are doing the work to ensure they get the same opportunities. Attacks on trans health care are at an all time high, and organizations like TransHealth in Northampton have never been more important. Sonia and our team stopped by to learn more about the critical work they're doing to provide gender affirming care for transgender and gender-diverse patients. We capped off the trip with a forum hosted by the Northampton Democratic City Committee, where Sonia was the only Gubernatorial candidate to attend. Our next Governor must be ready to take on our most pressing issues, and Sonia is dedicated to building a future that works for everyone, regardless of zip code. Talking to folks personally about the issues that matter most has been one of the most important parts of this campaign. And that’s exactly what Sonia did on this trip. We’re excited to continue meeting people in their communities and sharing how we can deliver bold, transformative leadership to Western Massachusetts and for the entire Commonwealth. [_**But Sonia’s counting on your support to deliver. Can you chip in $15 right away to show you’re ready for a bold and equitable Massachusetts?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44142821/340281081/5769926?refcode=em_20220414_f_t_westernmass&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmI4ODBjNC0zNWJjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DTa6tbwKFj5fDkMvLrBO3R4iAp5Mq4ElmtuAevUvu-Q=) Thanks for being a part of this team, Team Sonia

clean_body: We’re building a movement through Western Massachusetts and the entire Commonwealth. | | | | | Team, Sonia’s favorite part of running for Governor is hitting the road and meeting Bay Staters where they’re at. And recently, we spent some time in Western Massachusetts, and want to take a minute to share the highlights. We started off the trip — in true Sonia fashion — with a visit to Granny’s Baking Table. Sonia’s been a fan since we kicked off our campaign last summer, and the trip wouldn’t have been complete without stopping by. At Arise for Social Justice, Sonia was able to talk to the team about the important work they’re doing to support communities and fight for social justice in Springfield. The folks over at Enlace de Familias have been doing crucial work to empower Holyoke residents and provide needed food, housing, and education assistance for families. We were grateful to meet with and hear from them firsthand about the services they provide. Pregnant and parenting young mothers with low incomes deserve a high-quality education just like their peers — from high school to college. Organizations like the Care Center are doing the work to ensure they get the same opportunities. Attacks on trans health care are at an all time high, and organizations like TransHealth in Northampton have never been more important. Sonia and our team stopped by to learn more about the critical work they're doing to provide gender affirming care for transgender and gender-diverse patients. We capped off the trip with a forum hosted by the Northampton Democratic City Committee, where Sonia was the only Gubernatorial candidate to attend. Our next Governor must be ready to take on our most pressing issues, and Sonia is dedicated to building a future that works for everyone, regardless of zip code. Talking to folks personally about the issues that matter most has been one of the most important parts of this campaign. And that’s exactly what Sonia did on this trip. body:
It's out of control on Kemp's watch. | | | [ ](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=eceac9f8ac&e=89fb4d5220)
---
| Crime is out of control across the state.

**In Atlanta, rapes and murders are up 40%. There are more murders per capita in Atlanta than Chicago.**

This is outrageous, and it’s happening on Brian Kemp’s watch.

As if that’s not bad enough, **our Georgia State Patrol is smaller today than when Kemp took office.**

Officers are leaving the force left and right. That's because of Brian Kemp's failed leadership.

North Carolina, which is about the same size as Georgia, has **twice as many** state troopers.

As David said on the [radio](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=69925943cf&e=89fb4d5220) today, “I want to make sure that these heroes are supported. If you're going to get crime under control, you have to strengthen your law enforcement ability.”

In addition, there are **more illegal immigrants in Georgia than Arizona** , and our Governor hasn’t done a thing about it.

In fact, over 70% of counties in Florida have formal agreements with ICE to help identify and deport illegals. In Georgia, less than 3% have that arrangement.

The people of this state deserve better.

As Governor, David will **use every available tool** , including the National Guard if necessary, to address out of control crime.

He will double the size of the criminal interdiction force within the Georgia State Patrol, **deport criminal illegals** , and appoint law and order judges who will ensure criminals are held accountable.

Nothing is more important than keeping our communities safe, and our women and men in blue have no stronger ally than David Perdue.

– Team Perdue

| Team, I just wanted to send a quick note to say thanks to you, **we have a victory when it comes to voting rights in Arizona.**

Thanks to your support, we were able to push back on the AZ GOP’s lawsuit calling for an end to all early voting and mail-in voting. In addition to getting involved legally, we also mobilized against this brazen attempt at voter suppression. Thanks to you, the AZ Supreme Court just _threw out the GOP lawsuit, giving us a temporary victory._

I say temporary because the AZ GOP’s leading candidates for governor and secretary of state have pledged to continue fighting to achieve what the lawsuit failed to do – _end all early voting and mail-in voting, despite their previous uses of it._

**[Team, we may have won this round, but the threat to voting rights continues until we win these seats in November. In addition to getting involved legally, we also mobilized against this brazen attempt at voter suppression. Thanks to you, the AZ Supreme Court just threw out the GOP lawsuit, giving us a temporary victory. I say temporary because the AZ GOP’s leading candidates for governor and secretary of state have pledged to continue fighting to achieve what the lawsuit failed to do – end all early voting and mail-in voting, despite their previous uses of it. subject: Checking in after the convention

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=041422 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=041422] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Wow, friend, what a great MDP spring endorsement convention. To those who were there last Saturday, watching from home, or keeping up via email, thank you. It was an honor to be endorsed by so many passionate convention delegates who are ready to fight for our democracy.
Momentum is on our side, but we need to continue this energy if we’re going to prevail in November. Next week the Michigan GOP will endorse who they want to be by opponent. While we don’t know who it’s going to be yet, we know they will be fueled by the momentum of a nationwide anti-democratic movement – led by extremists like the DeVos family.
We saw it earlier this month when Trump stumped in Macomb County for my likely opponent and continued to promote the Big Lie. There is no question that in the coming months we’re going to face the most important battle for democracy in our lifetime. If you can, I’d appreciate it if you could donate to my re-election campaign today to ensure I have the resources to win in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=041422]
While we’re taking our campaign to the next level, we’re continuing to improve secretary of state services for Michiganders all across the state. Four years ago I promised to reduce the time it takes you to do business at a branch office and I am happy to report we’ve done that. The average branch office visit now lasts 20 minutes or less. And, this past week, we began holding Road to Restoration clinics, helping restore driver’s licenses for Michigan residents who have lost their license for violations like failing to pay a ticket or who had a hold placed on their license because of parking violations. These clinics are being held all across the state so please visit our website for more details. [https://www.michigan.gov/sos/0,4670,7-127-1627_108835---,00.html]
The next few months are going to be exciting as we grow this campaign. I am confident that if we can keep up the momentum from last weekend, our campaign will be victorious in November, especially if you’re with me. Support my campaign today with a donation. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=041422]

Jocelyn

subject: A look back at the DCCC blacklist
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Early in 2019, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC)
announced that it would be blacklisting vendors, staffers, and
organizations that support primary challengers to Democratic incumbents —
officially putting the interests of a handful of corporate-backed,
conservative Democrats above the will of Democratic voters.

It was a shocking attempt to protect corporate incumbents by blocking
working-class progressives from a slew of critical campaign resources. The
Democratic establishment created this blacklist after AOC defeated the 4th
most powerful Democrat in the House. Why? Because House leadership didn’t
want to lose more primaries to Justice Democrats.

Two of our recruits, Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, still defeated long-time
corporate incumbents in 2020 while the DCCC Blacklist was in effect. We
were not afraid of the Democratic establishment and we continue to win
races despite the odds stacked against us.

The DCCC announced an end to the blacklist after the 2020 elections — it
was more of a PR nightmare for them than an effective tool against
progressive primaries.

But we’re not surprised House Speaker Nancy Pelosi continues to support
conservative anti-abortion Democrat Henry Cuellar against Justice Democrat
Jessica Cisneros. Pelosi said, “I support my incumbents. I support every
one of them.”

It should matter to Democrats WHO the incumbents are and WHAT they stand
for — Cuellar voted against abortion rights, labor rights, AND worked to
block Build Back Better, all in the last year. Those are huge parts of the
Democratic agenda. But Pelosi is still backing Cuellar.

While we fight for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal, corporate
Democrats like Pelosi, Cuellar, and many others will try to protect
corporate profits and the status quo. Peter,
will you donate today to help us win our
primaries against the Democratic establishment and its Wall Street-backed
candidates?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/102748?refcode=em20220414-22869&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=22869%2E1203867%2E-K-H1F ]→ Yes, I can contribute right now to help Justice Democrats overcome
the odds and grow the Squad in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/102748?refcode=em20220414-22869&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=22869%2E1203867%2E-K-H1F ]Contribute

Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary
candidates.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Dear Patriot,

Thanks to my team for working together on election integrity to prevent Mark Zuckerberg, Jeff Bezos, or anyone else from pumping private money into public elections. When that happened in 2020 it violated fundamental principles of equal treatment of voters since it may have led to unequal opportunities to vote in different areas of our state.

Thanks to the Governor signing this bill, which passed with a super majority in both houses, no longer will Utah allow orchestrated attempts to convert official government election offices into get-out-the-vote operations for one political party and to insert political operatives into election offices in order to influence and manipulate the outcome of the election.

You read more on my website, [here](https://ut.votetimaalders.com/link.php?AGENCY=PMI&M=24009358&N=152017&L=83266&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly92b3RldGltYWFsZGVycy5jb20vYXJ0aWNsZXMvZ292ZXJub3ItY294LXNpZ25zLWVsZWN0aW9uLWludGVncml0eS1iaWxsLXB1c2hlZC1ieS10aW0tYWFsZGVycz91dG1fc291cmNlPSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1OZXdzbGV0dGVyJnV0bV90ZXJtPQ==).

Tim Aalders

body:
Did you see this week's news? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/af0a79492689/a-personal-message-from-courtney?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter,

Today, I want to address everyone directly to acknowledge the pain that all of us our feeling.

I'd prefer to keep talking about big cultural issues that North Carolinians face every day. What are my kids learning in school? Is my son getting bullied because of his sex and/or skin color? Is my daughter having to compete against a transgender female (biological male) on her swim or track team? These things matter, and we need to continue fighting to protect our kids, our families, our futures -- OUR COUNTRY!

All of those issues bring their own kind of pain. But the pain I need to address right now is a pain literally every American is sharing right now. It's the pain of having to make more to put the same amount of bread and butter on the dining table. It's the increased cost of the lamb for your Passover feast or the chocolate for your Easter egg hunts. This week, [it was announced that inflation rates surged 8.5%, to the highest levels since the Jimmy Carter economy of the early 80's](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=abf431d685&e=20ac8f046f).

INFLATION IS A HIDDEN TAX. And it's a big one. For some reason Biden has decided to do everything in his power to excise that tax. I suppose it goes with the territory. Raise taxes on businesses? Check. Raise taxes on the rich, including the rich who are already dead? Check. Raise taxes on the middle class? Check. Maybe Biden heard inflation was a tax and is now confusing it with his own tax hikes. Regardless, [Biden, and those in his party, fail to acknowledge that their policies exacerbate inflation](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=954a74b711&e=20ac8f046f).
---
|
---
| Make no mistake, inflation is a tax, and it's a tax on the middle class.**** Your parents and grandparents will exhaust their retirement quicker. Your kids' tuitions will require even larger loans at higher interest rates. Your food, housing, education, vehicles...all of it is more expensive than it was just a year ago. And don't get me started on gas prices.

**The MIDDLE CLASS are the ones most harmed by INFLATION! **

A vote for Courtney Geels is a vote for a voice of reason fighting for the middle class; someone who will pass legislation to ease inflation, not enflame it. A vote for Courtney, is a vote for a new voice to speak the truth into chaos, and one small step toward ensuring that our country thrives, **and I need your help!**
---
|
---
| _Early voting is April 28th - May 14th. The day of the Primary Election is May 17th._ **We need all hands on deck to make sure I have a strong showing in the Primary.** A strong showing in the primary will speak volumes, and will help ensure adequate resources are allocated to our district in the fight to win the General Election.

**Please sign up to volunteer to hand out flyers, wear Courtney shirts, and represent Courtney Geels to our neighbors at the polls.** Studies show that candidates perform better when they are well represented at the polls. Click the volunteer link below, and our team will find a convenient spot for you to help!
---
| [Volunteer](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=4807d8a41d&e=20ac8f046f "Volunteer")
---
| Thank you , **Peter**. I appreciate your support on my campaign and I look forward to representing you well in Washington DC.
---
| |
---
---
| Courtney Geels

clean_body: Did you see this week's news? | | | | | | | Dear Peter, Today, I want to address everyone directly to acknowledge the pain that all of us our feeling. I'd prefer to keep talking about big cultural issues that North Carolinians face every day. What are my kids learning in school? Is my son getting bullied because of his sex and/or skin color? Is my daughter having to compete against a transgender female (biological male) on her swim or track team? These things matter, and we need to continue fighting to protect our kids, our families, our futures -- OUR COUNTRY! All of those issues bring their own kind of pain. But the pain I need to address right now is a pain literally every American is sharing right now. It's the pain of having to make more to put the same amount of bread and butter on the dining table. It's the increased cost of the lamb for your Passover feast or the chocolate for your Easter egg hunts. This week, . INFLATION IS A HIDDEN TAX. And it's a big one. For some reason Biden has decided to do everything in his power to excise that tax. I suppose it goes with the territory. Raise taxes on businesses? Check. Raise taxes on the rich, including the rich who are already dead? Check. Raise taxes on the middle class? Check. Maybe Biden heard inflation was a tax and is now confusing it with his own tax hikes. Regardless, . | | Make no mistake, inflation is a tax, and it's a tax on the middle class.** Your parents and grandparents will exhaust their retirement quicker. Your kids' tuitions will require even larger loans at higher interest rates. Your food, housing, education, vehicles...all of it is more expensive than it was just a year ago. And don't get me started on gas prices. The MIDDLE CLASS are the ones most harmed by INFLATION! A vote for Courtney Geels is a vote for a voice of reason fighting for the middle class; someone who will pass legislation to ease inflation, not enflame it. A vote for Courtney, is a vote for a new voice to speak the truth into chaos, and one small step toward ensuring that our country thrives, and I need your help! | | Early voting is April 28th - May 14th. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Abbott is REALLY hurting people all over Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
I’m writing to you after a few really big weeks on the road in Texas.

Whether it was our enthusiastic town hall meeting in Temple or celebrating
Fiesta in San Antonio, I had the chance to meet and listen to so many of
the people that I want to serve as governor.

You can bet we talked about how Texas can do so much better on the big
things — like creating better jobs, improving our public schools and
moving forward on common sense ideas like expanding Medicaid — once we get
past the cruelty, incompetence and corruption of Greg Abbott.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55376?refcode=ema20220414-185038&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw ]Town Hall in Temple

But it was on the border, in cities like Del Rio, Laredo, Mercedes, Alamo
and McAllen that I got an urgent appreciation for the cost of Greg Abbott
to the people of Texas and why it’s so important that we defeat him in
November.

In Del Rio, I listened to members of the National Guard who told me what
it means to be used as props in Abbott’s political theater. Forced to
spend a year on a deployment to the border where they have no power to
arrest or detain migrants, they are struggling with morale and mental
health challenges and four of them have taken their lives since this
activation was ordered by Abbott.

In Laredo, I heard the extreme frustration with yet another Abbott border
stunt. Trying to score political points against the Biden administration,
Abbott ordered a partial blockade of commercial truck traffic coming into
the U.S. It is causing massive supply chain problems, driving up inflation
in Texas and throughout the country, and killing businesses in Laredo and
along the border.

And in the cities of the Rio Grande Valley, residents told me what it’s
like when your community is seen as a threat by your own governor, what
the talk of walls and invasions does to a town’s ability to recruit and
retain talent. And how a focus on political stunts fails to address
fundamental challenges in the Valley — like much needed infrastructure
investment, increased teacher pay and greater access to mental healthcare.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55376?refcode=ema20220414-185038&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw ]Town Hall in McAllen

Abbott is REALLY hurting people all over the state — including along the
border, a part of Texas that Abbott thinks he can actually win in
November.

I’ll continue to share that in person at these town halls across Texas,
I’ll make sure it’s on the front page of every Texas newspaper and that we
reach national audiences with this clear contrast, just like we did
Tuesday night on Lawrence O’Donnell’s show.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55376?refcode=ema20220414-185038&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw ]Beto on MSNBC

But that’s not going to be enough.

I need your help to reach every single voter in these communities to make
sure they understand just how bad Greg Abbott is for them and their
families and how much better I can serve them as governor.

I will turn your donations into digital ads that are targeted at the
Texans hurt most by Greg Abbott. I’ll use them to support our more than
60,000 volunteers to make sure they are knocking on the doors of the
voters who can provide our margin of victory.

I’ll make sure every voter in Texas understands the cost and consequence
of Greg Abbott and the opportunity to elect a governor who will help our
communities instead of hurting them.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55376?refcode=ema20220414-185038&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw ]Your donation is our best shot at winning this election.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55376?refcode=ema20220414-185038&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw ]Contribute $3

Thank you for giving,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1024&akid=185038%2E444211%2EAiy_rw

Pol. Adv. Paid for by Beto for Texas.

I know which side I’m on. Are you with me? Sincerely, Tiffany Shedd Paid for by Shedd for Attorney General. Authorized by Shedd for Attorney General.

# Campaign Update: We Launched Our First TV Ad This Week!

Friends and supporters,

This week was packed with exciting news for the Nancy Mace for Congress campaign.

The highlights:
* Announced record $1.2m fundraising report
* Launched our first TV ad
* Joined Shannon Bream on Fox News to talk Ukraine
* Joined Martha MacCallum for a must-see interview about Hunter Biden

## Record Fundraising Haul
Thanks to our incredible grassroots supporters, we raised a whopping $1.2m in January through March, with an average donation of $47! That's roughly twice what my Democratic and Republican opponents raised combined!

We couldn't be happier for these results. This shows a clear sign that Republicans are backing Congresswoman Nancy Mace's proven conservative voting record for re-election in 2022!

## First TV Ad

Check out my first TV Ad, titled "Soldiers": [https://youtu.be/S-CSmBqxEzM](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=8cc11fc5bb&e=ddc57b5ede)

Joe Biden mandated American troops and Border Patrol agents get the vaccine but not illegal immigrants.

Stop treating illegal immigrants better than our brave men & women in uniform.

Enough is enough!

Finish the wall. Secure the border. No mandates!

## Fox News Appearances
It's exciting to see our local congresswoman stepping up to be a leader shaping the national conversation on Fox News.

Here are her appearances in the last week:

**Shannon Bream**
[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=7333484a6e&e=ddc57b5ede)
Watch on YouTube: [https://youtu.be/psuwkUAwP8I](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=c95ad07713&e=ddc57b5ede)

Nancy Mace joins Shannon Bream to discuss Ukraine and fact check the Biden Administration's flimsy attempt to claim it prepared months and months in advance of Putin's brutal invasion.

Stay tuned to the end to see the last question about Hunter Biden's laptop!

**Martha MacCallum** [](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=d81efd4f99&e=ddc57b5ede)

Nancy Mace joins Martha MacCallum for a must-see interview about what she can do on the Oversight Committee.

When Republicans take the majority next year, Mace declared one of the first subpoenas they will issue is for Hunter Biden to testify about the texts and emails from his scandalous laptop.

It's exciting to think that our local congresswoman can be leading the charge next year to get to the bottom of Biden family corruption.

But first, it's time to win our primary campaign!

## Join #TeamMace Today!
Our campaign is going full steam ahead going into the June 14 Republican primary. It is important to have a proven conservative with a record we can rely on to represent our Lowcountry values in Washington.

We can't do this without your help! We're building a team of all-star volunteers to help us:

* Be social media ambassadors
* Knock doors
* Make phone calls
* Request yard signs
* Deliver yard signs
* Attend events

If you would like to join our team, [click this link here](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=3899ce4354&e=ddc57b5ede) to sign up, and someone will be in touch with you shortly.

Thank you so much again for all your help, and together we will deliver on Election Day this June 14th.

Team Nancy Mace for Congress
